detail.title: Customer Journey Manager
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

INNOVATE without boundaries! At Milwaukee Tool, our people and culture are foundational to our success. We provide team members with the tools, resources, and support needed to make an impact, advance business priorities, and contribute to meaningful outcomes across the organization.


Your Role on Our Team

As a Journey Manager at Milwaukee Tool, you will own delivery within a team or discipline for one or more assigned end user and/or distributor journeys. This role connects user needs, business objectives, operational considerations, technology capabilities, and organizational priorities to develop actionable journey strategies, measurable outcomes, and aligned execution plans.


A Journey Manager influences team priorities, manages delivery tradeoffs, and develops people, processes, or projects to improve assigned journey outcomes. This role operates with autonomy to manage cross-team execution tradeoffs, align stakeholders around priorities, and contribute to Journey Management standards, tools, and practices as part of the broader Journey Management function across Milwaukee Tool. This role has potential to have direct reports; people development happens through coaching, partnership, and influence regardless of reporting structure. Decision rights: the Journey Manager decides prioritization within assigned journeys, recommends investment and roadmap decisions to partner teams, and escalates cross-journey tradeoffs.


You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

  • Own and manage assigned end user or distributor journeys including digital and non-digital aspects, ensuring journey strategies, artifacts, priorities, and improvement plans remain current, actionable, and aligned to business objectives.
  • Translate customer feedback, Voice of Customer, research, behavioral data, operational data, analytics, and market insights into prioritized recommendations with clear user value and business value, identifying customer needs, pain points, moments that matter, friction points, gaps, and handoff breakdowns across digital, physical, service, and operational touchpoints.
  • Develop and maintain the core journey artifacts: current-state and future-state journey maps, service blueprints, personas, opportunity and solution inventories, measurement frameworks, roadmaps, and supporting documentation.
  • Facilitate the journey operating rhythm with cross-functional partners and stakeholders: defining current state, research report outs, opportunity frame up and prioritization, solution prioritization, and performance reviews.
  • Lead alignment across teams responsible for different portions of the journey, clarifying roles, responsibilities, dependencies, decision points, and risks, and influence product, project, roadmap, and solution teams to incorporate journey priorities into delivery plans, backlogs, and execution work.
  • Represent customer and distributor needs in business planning, product development, process design, service design, and decision-making, partnering with UX, Research, Analytics, Product, Digital Product, Brand, Channel, Service, Sales, Operations, Technology, and other teams.
  • Define journey-level objectives, key performance indicators, success measures, and measurement frameworks; monitor journey performance and root causes of friction; and track and communicate the impact of journey improvements, connecting OKRs, metrics, insights, opportunities, initiatives, and outcomes into a clear journey narrative for stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Develop and maintain a prioritized roadmap of journey opportunities and solutions based on customer impact, business value, feasibility, effort, risk, strategic alignment, desirability, and viability, and translate them into defined initiatives, business cases, requirements, pilots, proof-of-concepts, or action plans.
  • Contribute to Journey Management practice development by applying standards, experience principles, and governance practices, improving tools, sharing learnings, and identifying opportunities to simplify processes, reduce friction, and sustain improvements across journeys.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Business, Marketing, Customer Experience, Human-Centered Design, UX, Product Management, Digital Product Management, Service Design, Project Management or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in journey management or an adjacent discipline (customer experience, product management, service design, UX, operations) managing people, processes, projects, cross-functional initiatives, or assigned journeys with accountability for delivery within a team or discipline. Adjacent-discipline experience counts fully.
  • Experience developing and using customer journey maps, service blueprints, experience strategies, opportunity areas, measurement frameworks, or related customer-focused artifacts.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights, customer feedback, business data, and operational context into clear recommendations.
  • Experience defining, managing, or reporting on key performance indicators, success measures, dashboards, or performance measurement frameworks.
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to lead cross-functional groups through discovery, alignment, prioritization, governance, and decision-making.
  • Strong project, program, or initiative management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, risks, and competing demands.
  • Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships, influence without direct authority, and drive progress across business, product, digital, design, analytics, operations, and technology teams.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous environments, manage cross-team execution tradeoffs, influence team priorities, and drive clarity across teams.
  • Ability to travel as needed for research, field visits, customer or distributor observation, and team collaboration.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

  • Experience working in a large, complex, matrixed organization and driving outcomes through influence rather than formal authority.
  • Experience connecting customer experience opportunities to business outcomes, OKRs, commercial priorities, operational performance, or measurable indicators.
  • Familiarity with journey management platforms, journey mapping tools, research repositories, analytics dashboards, CRM, Voice of Customer platforms, digital experience tools, or product and portfolio management tools.
  • Experience with human-centered design, service design, design thinking, Jobs To Be Done, customer experience measurement, continuous improvement, experimentation, or test-and-learn methodologies.
  • Experience facilitating workshops, synthesizing research, identifying opportunity areas, and translating insights into roadmaps, initiatives, or execution plans.
  • Ability to translate complex customer, operational, and analytical information into clear narratives, decisions, and action.

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

  • Improved customer or distributor outcomes, including satisfaction, effort, engagement, conversion, retention, or other journey-specific measures.
  • Reduced friction, pain points, repeat contacts, process failures, or experience gaps across assigned journeys.
  • Increased consistency and effectiveness across journey touchpoints, channels, teams, and operational areas.
  • Delivery and measurable impact of prioritized journey improvements, pilots, or initiatives.
  • Cross-functional alignment, adoption of journey priorities, and visibility into journey performance and opportunities.
  • Sustained improvements to customer experience and business performance.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

  • Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • Generous 401(k) savings plan.
  • Education assistance.
  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service where available.
  • Additional benefits available through Milwaukee Tool’s benefits resources.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Field Sales and Marketing Representative - Jupiter, FL
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

 

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

 

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

 

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

 

Duties and Responsibilities:

·        Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

·        Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

·        Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

·        Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

·        Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

·        Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

·        Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

·        Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

·        Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

 

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

 

Job / Employment Requirements:

·        Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

·        Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

·        Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

·        Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

·        Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

·        Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

·        Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

·        Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

·        Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

·        Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

·        Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

·        Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

·        Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

·        Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

·        The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

·        Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

·        Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

·        Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

 

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)
  • The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000
  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)
  • Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year
  • Company iPhone and iPad
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available
  • Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more
  • 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)
  • Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)
  • Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date
  • Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

 

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

 

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

detail.title: Supply Planning Analyst I
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

At Milwaukee Tool, we don’t just design tools—we create solutions that redefine industry standards. Our relentless commitment to innovation drives everything we do, and we’re looking for a Supply Planner to help ensure our products get into the hands of our customers on time and with precision. If you're a strategic thinker with a passion for supply chain optimization, we want you on our team!

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply planning processes and overall efficiency.

  • Understanding of Supply Chain planning tools, software, and ERP systems

detail.title: Transportation Analyst I
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

The Transportation Analyst I provides day-to-day operational and analytical support for Milwaukee Tool’s transportation network. Serving as a first point of contact for transportation-related needs. This role coordinates inbound and outbound shipments, supports carrier performance and compliance, resolves service issues, manages freight claims, carrier invoice payment exceptions, and identifies opportunities to improve quality, service, and costs. The analyst partners across the organization to deliver reliable transportation solutions and uses data to support fact-based decisions and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills, along with proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, AI tools, and PowerPoint.


You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:     

  • Coordinate inbound and outbound transportation activities, including shipment scheduling, routing, booking, tracking, expediting, and delivery follow-up.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Supply Planning, Sourcing, Service, Manufacturing, Sales, Merchandising, Distribution, suppliers, and carriers to support business and customer requirements.
  • Monitor daily shipment activity and proactively resolve lost, misrouted, delayed, or damaged freight with carriers and internal stakeholders.
  • Provide freight quotes and secure carrier capacity for expedited, ad hoc, and special shipment requests.
  • Evaluate expedited shipment requests and recommend the most cost-effective service option; escalate excess-cost transactions for appropriate approval.
  • Develop and maintain routing guides, supplier requirements, and transportation compliance standards that balance service, quality, and cost objectives.
  • Analyze freight and routing data to identify noncompliance, service gaps, cost drivers, and process-improvement opportunities.
  • Track carrier performance across transportation modes, communicate results, and escalate recurring service issues for corrective action.
  • Manage freight claims, including claim submission, documentation, follow-up, and recovery tracking.
  • Research and resolve transportation-related customer issues in collaboration with carriers and the broader distribution network.
  • Support freight payment exception resolution and help ensure transportation charges are accurate and appropriately documented.
  • Lead or support data-driven cost mitigation and continuous-improvement initiatives.
  • Provide operational coverage and support for the Transportation Manager as needed.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:  

  • 0-2 years of experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, or a related operational environment preferred.· Bachelor’s degree in transportation, operations, logistics, supply chain management, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant education and experience will be considered.
  • Ability to extract, organize, manipulate, and interpret transportation and operational data.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills for working with carriers, suppliers, customers, and internal business partners.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to time-sensitive issues, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions and contribute within a one-team environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans
  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan
  • Education assistance
  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service
  • And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

INNOVATE without boundaries! 

At TTI, our people and culture drive success. As Milwaukee Tool, Consumer brands, and TTI grow, we are strengthening the technology, data, and digital experiences supporting the employee lifecycle. The Vice President, Talent Technology will build a modern, scalable ecosystem that improves employee and manager experiences, analytics, and business performance.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Talent, this leader owns the global Talent Technology portfolio across Milwaukee Tool, Consumer brands, and TTI. The role defines the strategy, architecture, operating model, governance, standards, and roadmap to scale HR systems, data, and digital experiences.

 

As a Talent Leadership Team member, this leader partners with Talent, Information Technology, Finance, Legal, and business executives to translate strategy into technology priorities that improve efficiency, insight, compliance, and growth. The role leads through others, aligns product, delivery, and support teams, and establishes a unified vision for Talent Technology.

 

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities: 

  • Enterprise Talent Technology Strategy

    • Evolve the strategy for emerging platforms, automation, and AI-enabled talent solutions.

    • Use workforce data, business indicators, and stakeholder feedback to prioritize investments and improve access, scalability, personalization, and consistency.
    • Define measures beyond uptime and ticket volume, including adoption, efficiency, data quality, and business impact; provide executives with clear reporting on performance, priorities, risks, and opportunities.
    • Build a product and continuous-improvement mindset focused on practical, high-quality employee, manager, and candidate experiences.

    • Build and develop a high-performing Talent Technology organization grounded in accountability, innovation, business partnership, and operational excellence.
    • Lead through other leaders with clear roles, decision rights, expectations, and accountability.
    • Develop Director and Manager-level leaders who can scale the function, influence partners, deliver quality solutions, and lead change.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Information Systems, Computer Science, Analytics, Organizational Development, or related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive Talent/HR Technology, HRIS, People Analytics, Enterprise Systems, Digital Product Management, or related experience.
  • Senior leadership experience leading through other leaders and managing multi-layered teams.
  • Proven success defining and executing enterprise or multi-business HR technology, systems transformation, data, or digital experience strategies.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to influence executives, connect investments to strategy and performance, and drive change in a complex, high-growth matrix.
  • Experience building scalable operating models, governance, architecture, data standards, integrations, analytics, product practices, vendor partnerships, and measurement systems.
  • Effective partnership with Talent Centers of Excellence, Talent Business Partners, IT, Security, Legal, Finance, and business leaders.
  • Demonstrated use of data and business insight to prioritize work, measure impact, and improve outcomes.
  • Proven experience developing leaders, building high-performing teams, and strengthening succession and bench depth.
  • Strong executive communication skills; ability to simplify complexity, frame recommendations, and influence decisions.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 20%.
  • This role has an in office requirement and is based in Milwaukee, WI

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

  • Talent technology leadership in a manufacturing, consumer products, industrial, engineering, commercial, retail, field sales, or product-driven organization.
  • Experience across multiple brands, business units, regions, or operating models.
  • Experience transforming an HR technology, HRIS, people analytics, or digital talent function at scale, including large HCM implementations or global consolidations.
  • Experience with talent acquisition, learning, performance, compensation, workforce planning, and AI-enabled tools.
  • Experience linking technology to job architecture, career pathways, competencies, and workforce planning.
  • Experience supporting multilingual or global organizations is preferred

Why This Role Matters:

The Vice President, Talent Technology is a force multiplier for growth. As Milwaukee Tool, Consumer brands, and TTI scale, faster and more consistent technology, data, and digital experiences become a strategic advantage.


This role moves Talent Technology beyond system administration to build the data, digital experiences, reliability, and infrastructure needed for growth. detail.title: HR Coordinator
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., is looking for an HR Coordinator in Anderson, SC. The HR Coordinator provides operational, data, and coordination support that enables the HR Business Partner team to deliver effective, consistent, and proactive HR partnership to the business. This role supports the execution of employee lifecycle processes, workforce data management, HR reporting, talent-cycle coordination, compliance documentation, and employee experience initiatives.

This position serves as a key connector between HR Business Partners, HR Operations, Recruiting, Org Effectiveness, Payroll, Workday/HRIS support, leaders, and employees to ensure HR processes are executed accurately, timely, and consistently.

The role requires strong attention to detail, discretion, follow-through, customer service, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while supporting a People First employee experience.

Primary Responsibilities

HRBP Enablement and Business Support

  • Provide day-to-day operational and coordination support to HR Business Partners, helping ensure follow-through on HR actions, talent processes, employee documentation, and business priorities.
  • Track HRBP-related action items, deadlines, documentation needs, and process milestones to support timely execution and visibility.
  • Prepare materials, reports, trackers, communications, and meeting resources that support HRBP discussions with leaders.
  • Work with Org Effectiveness to help organize HRBP operating rhythms, including talent reviews, performance cycle activities, engagement action planning, employee listening follow-up, and workforce planning support.
  • Serve as a coordination point between HRBPs, leaders, employees, and HR specialty groups to help route questions, requests, and process needs to the appropriate owner.

Employee Lifecycle and HR Process Execution

  • Coordinate and support employee lifecycle transactions, including new hires, transfers, promotions, compensation changes, status changes, organizational updates, and terminations.
  • Support onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure a consistent employee experience and compliance with established procedures.
  • Maintain accurate employee records, performance documentation, organizational data, and HR-related files in accordance with company policies and retention requirements.
  • Assist with preparing and distributing HR-related documents, correspondence, forms, and business communications.
  • Support routine employee inquiries by helping direct employees and leaders to the appropriate HR resource, process, or system.

Workforce Data, Reporting, and HR Systems

  • Maintain HRIS data integrity in Workday, UKG Dimensions, and other HR systems by ensuring employee, organizational, and reporting data is accurate and current.
  • Assist with recurring reporting related to headcount, turnover, open positions, employee movement, attendance, engagement, compliance, and other HR metrics.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts by helping simplify, standardize, and document HR processes, tools, templates, and SOPs.

Talent, Performance, Engagement, and Culture Support

  • Support employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, service awards, culture activities, and company events.
  • Assist HRBPs with preparing materials and follow-up items related to talent planning, succession planning, employee development, retention actions, and leader support.
  • Coordinate logistics, tracking, communications, and documentation for HR-led programs that support culture, employee experience, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Model and reinforce TTI Consumer’s cultural values, including People First, Total Ownership, Candid Communication, Innovation Leaders, and One Team Mentality.

Compliance, Confidentiality, and Employee Relations Support

  • Assist with audits, compliance reporting, and maintenance of employment records to ensure adherence to federal, state, local, and company requirements.
  • Support HRBPs with employee relations documentation, meeting preparation, case tracking, and follow-up while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and discretion.
  • Help ensure documentation is complete, timely, and organized for performance, corrective action, investigations, leaves, accommodations, job changes, and other HR matters.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism, sound judgment, and discretion.

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Knowledge of HR processes, employment practices, and compliance requirements preferred.
  • Experience working with HRIS systems and maintaining employee data is beneficial but not required.

detail.title: Machine Learning Engineer II - Operations
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Excited to grow your career? 

 
We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! 


Our people make all the difference in our success.


Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.  


At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to drive disruptive new technologies and solutions across our operations teams. Our Operations Teams are responsible for the manufacturing, service, supply chain, and quality systems that bring our products to life and into the hands of our users. We continue to invest in advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI capabilities to transform how we run our plants, optimize production, and anticipate issues before they reach the line. We’re pushing the limits in data engineering, deep learning, and generative AI applied to real-world manufacturing problems.


Your role on our team:

As a Machine Learning Engineer II, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions that improve how Milwaukee Tool manufactures and services products. Working cross-functionally with operations, quality, supply chain, engineering, and service teams, you will develop and implement data-driven solutions that address real-world business and operational challenges globally.


You will contribute to the full machine learning lifecycle, from data engineering and model development to deployment and monitoring on Azure and Databricks. A key aspect of this role is partnering with our Global and Service Teams to deploy, validate, and support machine learning solutions in operational environments, ensuring models deliver measurable value where they are used.


This role is ideal for a self-motivated engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams, and takes ownership of delivering impactful, production-ready solutions.


What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or other scientific or engineering discipline. 
  • Completed course work or specialization in Machine Learning and/or Data Science using one or more deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, etc). 
  • At least one year of hands-on experience applying machine learning principles and algorithms to dynamic, real-world problems. 
  • Demonstrated experience applying fundamental machine learning algorithms and techniques in a non-coursework setting (e.g. unsupervised or supervised learning, classification/regression, dimensionality reduction, model optimization). 
  • Demonstrated experience with machine learning and AI methods such as CNNs, transformers, or computer vision. 
  • Proficiency in big data transformation using Spark, SQL, and Python (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, Matplotlib). 
  • Sold mathematical foundation in statistics, linear algebra, calculus and optimization. 
  • Experience working with ML deployments using CI/CD pipelines (Azure, Databricks, MLFlow) and edge devices (GPU, Containerization, Linux). 
  • Excellent problem-solving and technical communication skills translating complex ML deployments into language that non-technical audience can understand.  
  • Experience collaborating with global teams, including a willingness to adjust working hours to accommodate international time zones and ensure project alignment.  
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time (domestic and international). 

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Machine Learning or related field is preferred. 
  • At least three years of hands-on experience applying machine learning principles and algorithms to dynamic, real-world problems. 
  • Experience with time-series modeling for use cases such as demand forecasting, predictive maintenance, yield prediction, or process anomaly detection. 
  • Experience with computer vision for use cases such as defect detection, missing part detection, part quality inspection, part counting, etc.  
  • Proven track record of developing, deploying, and scaling AI or ML solutions tied to measurable operations outcomes (e.g. scrap reduction, throughput, OEE, on-time delivery, inventory turns). 
  • Desktop application or Web app development experience (e.g. building tools or UIs that put models in the hands of plant and operations users). 
  • Hands-on data engineering experience building pipelines on Databricks/Spark against large operational datasets (MES, ERP, SCADA, IoT/Sensor Telemetry). 
  • Experience applying generative AI or LLMs to operations problems such as knowledge retrieval, document processing, or assistive tooling for plant teams.  
  • Experience in developing, maintaining and using MLOps pipelines and ensure efficient deployment, monitoring, and scaling of ML models in production. 
  • Experience developing and deploying machine learning algorithms to edge environments. 

We provide these great perks and benefits:

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans. 
  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan. 
  • Education assistance. 
  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service. 
  • And many more, check out our benefits site HERE. 

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Advanced Engineering
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Mechanical Design Engineer - Advanced Engineering

 

Applicants must currently hold a U.S. work-authorized status that supports long-term employment and a pathway to permanent residency. Candidates in visitor, student, exchange, treaty investor/trader, or other temporary statuses that do not readily support employment-based permanent residency will not be considered.


Techtronic Industries, the world leader in cordless technology across Outdoor Power Equipment, Power Tools, Floor Care Appliances, and Accessories, is seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer for the Ryobi Outdoor Products Advanced Engineering team at our Innovation Center in Anderson, SC.

This role is ideal for a hands-on mechanical engineer who enjoys turning ambiguous product ideas into working, tested, manufacturable solutions before they enter formal product development. You will help develop future outdoor power equipment technologies by converting early concepts into validated mechanical systems that improve performance, durability, user experience, and manufacturability.


Advanced Engineering operates upstream of traditional new product development. The team explores new mechanisms, proves out key technical assumptions, reduces risk through analysis, prototyping, and testing, and transitions mature concepts to product development teams.

The Advanced Engineering team is highly collaborative, deeply hands-on, and driven by curiosity, learning, and practical problem solving as we develop innovative outdoor products that create real value for our customers.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop advanced mechanical concepts for next-generation outdoor power equipment and battery-powered outdoor products
  • Create mechanisms, structures, and integrated assemblies that balance performance, durability, manufacturability, cost, and user experience
  • Use first-principles analysis, hand calculations, simulation, benchmarking, and test data to guide design decisions
  • Build, test, and iterate functional prototypes to quickly validate key assumptions, identify risks, and mature concepts
  • Define system requirements, user operation methods, design trade-offs, and acceptance criteria for advanced mechanical systems
  • Translate early concepts into robust, production-minded designs that can be handed off to downstream engineering teams
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Industrial Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to develop balanced technical solutions
  • Communicate technical findings, risks, recommendations, and next steps clearly to engineering leadership and project stakeholders
  • Support project planning by contributing to milestone definition, schedule inputs, prototype needs, and technical risk assessments

 

Required Qualifications:

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline
  • 3+ years of mechanical design experience in product development, advanced engineering, concept maturation, or innovation-focused roles
  • Strong proficiency with 3D CAD, such as NX, SolidWorks, or similar tools
  • Strong mechanical design fundamentals, including mechanisms, structures, engineering materials, manufacturing processes, and tolerance considerations
  • Experience building prototypes, developing test plans, evaluating results, and using data to improve designs
  • Ability to manage multiple projects or concepts at different stages of maturity
  • Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, ownership, curiosity, and proactivity
  • Willingness to travel approximately 5-10%, including domestic and international travel as needed

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing consumer products, outdoor power equipment, power tools, or similar high-volume mechanical products
  • Experience using FEA, CFD, dynamic simulation, gear design tools, or other advanced analysis methods to guide product design
  • Experience with rapid prototyping across multiple materials and processes
  • Familiarity with vibration, sound, airflow, thermal, durability, or performance testing
  • Familiarity with integrated electrical and mechanical systems, including motors, batteries, sensors, and control interfaces
  • Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field

Tools & Technologies:
Candidates should be comfortable using modern engineering tools to develop, analyze, communicate, and validate mechanical designs.

  • Relevant tools include MS Office, NX, SolidWorks, Ansys Mechanical, LS-DYNA, Fluent, Discovery, KISSsoft, rapid prototyping equipment, and measurement tools for vibration, sound, airflow, durability, or product performance.

Why Join This Team?

  • Work on future product platforms and advanced technologies before they enter formal product development
  • Use hands-on prototyping, testing, and analysis to influence real product decisions
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and leadership teams
  • Gain high visibility by helping define product architectures, technical strategies, and risk-reduction plans
  • Help shape the technical direction of products that reach a large base of real-world users

 

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • A self-starter who can move quickly from idea to prototype while staying grounded in engineering fundamentals
  • A maker-minded engineer who enjoys building, testing, troubleshooting, and learning through iteration
  • A collaborative contributor who brings broad technical experience, curiosity, and practical creativity to technical brainstorming
  • A clear communicator who can translate complex technical information for technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • An engineer who is comfortable with ambiguity and can reduce uncertainty through analysis, testing, and data-driven design decisions
  • A practical innovator who wants to help shape future outdoor products that users can feel, hear, see, and experience

Job Description:

 

Senior Manager – Security & Safety

 

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us!

 

Milwaukee Tool is seeking a Senior Manager - Security & Safety to be a strategic partner and lead key programs and initiatives focused on protecting employees, visitors, and facilities through proactive security planning, workplace violence prevention, emergency preparedness, threat assessment, and crisis readiness.

This role will lead the implementation and ongoing management of Milwaukee Tool's physical security program for U.S. locations. The individual will provide strategic oversight while actively participating in the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Security Management System, risk-based facility standards, security audit program, workplace violence prevention initiatives, and emergency preparedness and response programs. The role requires the ability to independently develop and maintain program elements while leveraging internal and external subject matter expertise as needed.

The Senior Manager – Security & Safety reports to the VP of Environmental, Health, Safety & Sustainability and works cross-functionally with EHSS, Corporate Business Operations, Talent, Legal, Operational Leaders, and Corporate Communications.

 

Key Responsibilities

Physical Security Strategy and Program Management

  • Develop and maintain the enterprise physical security strategy and multi-year roadmap, including the prioritization of security initiatives, capital investments, and program maturity objectives.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Milwaukee Tool's Physical Security Management System, including policies, standards, governance processes, performance metrics, corrective action management, and annual program reviews.
  • Conduct security risk assessments and vulnerability reviews and partner with locations to prioritize and implement recommendations.
  • Identify threats, vulnerabilities, and opportunities to improve employee and visitor safety.
  • Partner with Corporate Business Operations and business leaders to incorporate physical security requirements into new facilities, renovations, expansions, and workplace changes.
  • Provide security requirements and recommendations for sustainable security technologies, facility protection measures, and capital improvement projects based on identified risks, business needs, and corporate security standards.
  • Establish and maintain the facility security classification model, minimum security standards, and risk-based requirements for manufacturing, distribution, service, laboratory, and corporate locations.
  • Develop and manage the enterprise security audit, assessment, and corrective action program to verify compliance with corporate security standards and drive continuous improvement.

Workplace Violence Prevention and Emergency Response

  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of Milwaukee Tool’s workplace violence prevention program.
  • Support processes for reporting, assessing, and managing workplace violence concerns.
  • Partner with Talent, Legal, EHSS, and business leaders to support workplace violence prevention, threat assessment, and incident response activities.
  • Promote awareness and reporting of concerning behaviors and potential threats.
  • Lead emergency preparedness programs, drills, and exercises for Milwaukee Tool corporate locations.
  • Develop and maintain emergency response procedures for corporate locations, including fire, severe weather, evacuation, shelter-in-place, and other applicable scenarios.
  • Coordinate corporate fire drills, severe weather drills, tabletop exercises, and preparedness activities.
  • Conduct after-action reviews and drive continuous improvement following drills, exercises, and actual emergency events.
  • Share best practices, lessons learned, and preparedness resources across the organization.

Program Leadership & Training

  • Develop and deliver training programs related to security awareness, workplace violence prevention, active threat preparedness, and emergency response.
  • Create awareness campaigns focused on situational awareness, emergency preparedness, and workplace violence prevention and reporting.
  • Lead the development and training for emergency response coordinators and preparedness champions on effective emergency response.
  • Develop performance measures and provide leadership with updates on program implementation and effectiveness.

·             

Qualifications

  • Ten or more years of experience in security, emergency preparedness, risk management, workplace violence prevention, safety leadership, law enforcement, military, or a related field.

·            Bachelor's degree in Security Management, Emergency Management, Occupational Safety, Risk Management, Criminal Justice, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  •  
  • Experience developing or implementing enterprise physical security programs, standards, or management systems.

 

  • Experience communicating with and influencing senior leaders in an organization.
  • Experience conducting risk assessments and developing risk mitigation strategies.
  • Experience developing training programs and facilitating exercises or drills.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive program implementation.
  • Ability to travel periodically within the United States.

Success in This Role

Success in this role will be determined through:

  • Successful development and implementation of the enterprise physical security strategy and Security Management System.
  • Consistent application of risk-based security standards and facility classification requirements.
  • Effective implementation of workplace violence prevention, active threat preparedness, and emergency response programs.
  • High-quality execution of corporate emergency drills and exercises.
  • Effective prioritization and timely completion of security improvements, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Timely completion of security risk assessments and implementation of prioritized risk-reduction measures.
  • Increased employee awareness and preparedness.
  • Strong cross-functional partnerships and program adoption.

detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Design Engineer III – New Product Development Engineering (OPE)

The Design Engineer III is responsible for hands-on mechanical design execution for moderate to high‑complexity outdoor power equipment (OPE) systems and subsystems. This role owns detailed design execution from concept to production, with a strong emphasis on robust design, manufacturability, validation, and cost. Operating within the Outdoor Engineering organization, the Design Engineer III functions as a technical leader and subject‑matter expert for assigned components and assemblies, partnering closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and global suppliers to deliver competitive, production‑ready designs.


Key Job Functions & Responsibilities


Technical Design Ownership

  • Owns end‑to‑end mechanical design execution for assigned components, sub‑assemblies, or systems from concept, layout, and detailed CAD through validation and production release.
  • Develops and maintains 3D CAD models, 2D drawings, GD&T, tolerance stacks, and specifications to ensure functional performance, regulatory compliance, durability, safety, and manufacturability.
  • Ability to analyze problems and provide design trade‑off analyses (performance, cost, weight, manufacturability, reliability) and documents rationale for design decisions.
  • Applies structured problem‑solving methods to resolve design issues, field failures, and manufacturing concerns.
  • Demonstrates strong engineering judgment and accountability for design quality and performance.


Design for Manufacturing, Cost, and Quality

  • Designs components optimized for high‑volume manufacturing, assembly efficiency, tooling capability, and supplier process constraints.
  • Partners with Sourcing and suppliers to evaluate manufacturing processes, tooling concepts, and cost drivers early in development.
  • Ensures designs comply with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and applicable UL / ANSI / CSA / ISO expectations.


Verification & Validation

  • Defines DFMEA inputs, design risks, and mitigation strategies for owned designs.
  • Develops and executes design verification plans including tolerance validation, stress analysis, durability testing, environmental testing, and abuse testing.
  • Uses data‑driven test results to refine designs and confirm requirements are met with appropriate margin.
  • Reviews and approves engineering changes, deviation requests, and corrective actions related to owned designs.


Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Works closely with Product Management to translate customer needs and CTQs into clear engineering requirements.
  • Supports Manufacturing Engineering during pilot builds, PPAP, and ramp‑up by resolving build issues and incorporating feedback into design revisions.
  • Collaborates with Quality, Compliance, and Reliability teams to support certifications, audits, and failure investigations.
  • Provides clear technical communication to global engineering, sourcing, and supplier teams.
  • Contributes to the development and improvement of design standards, test methods, and engineering processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 4 years of design experience in consumer, industrial, or electromechanical products.
  • Strong proficiency in 3D CAD (Creo / SolidWorks / NX or equivalent), detailed drawings, and GD&T.
  • Demonstrated experience with materials, manufacturing processes, tooling, and supplier‑built components.
  • Experience leading design verification and validation activities using data‑driven methods.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and technical communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, results‑driven product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, small engines, or high‑load electromechanical systems.
  • Hands‑on experience supporting pilot builds and production ramp‑ups.
  • Familiarity with global supplier collaboration and Asia‑based manufacturing.
  • Experience supporting UL / CSA / ANSI compliance activities.

Travel

  • Up to 10% travel (international and domestic).

Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth. 

 

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. ABOUT TTI

Techtronic Industries is a fast-growing world leader in Power Tools, Accessories, Hand Tools, Outdoor Power Equipment, and Floor Care for Do-It-Yourself (DIY), professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, maintenance, construction, and infrastructure industries. The Company is committed to accelerating the transformation of these industries through superior environmentally friendly cordless technology. At TTI Anderson, our brand RYOBI is recognized worldwide for its deep heritage and cordless product platform of superior quality, outstanding performance, safety, productivity, and compelling innovation.

 

JOB SUMMARY

The Mechanical Engineer as part of the Advanced Engineering team is a technical lead with responsibilities of developing, analyzing, and maturing complex mechanical systems for next-generation tools. This role focuses on transforming early concepts and emerging technologies into robust, feasible mechanical solutions through calculations, analysis, prototyping, and testing. The Advanced Engineering team is highly collaborative, deeply hands-on, and driven by curiosity and learning as we develop new and innovative consumer power tool products.

detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Sr. Design Engineer – New Product Development Engineering

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., is currently looking for a Senior Design Engineer in Anderson, SC. The Senior Design Engineer is responsible for hands-on mechanical design execution for moderate to high‑complexity outdoor power equipment (OPE) systems and subsystems. This role owns detailed design execution from concept to production, with a strong emphasis on robust design, manufacturability, validation, and cost. Operating within the Outdoor Engineering organization, the Sr. Design Engineer I functions as a technical leader and subject‑matter expert for assigned components and assemblies, partnering closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and global suppliers to deliver competitive, production‑ready designs.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Technical Design Ownership

  • Owns end‑to‑end mechanical design execution for assigned components, sub‑assemblies, or systems from concept, layout, and detailed CAD through validation and production release.
  • Develops and maintains 3D CAD models, 2D drawings, GD&T, tolerance stacks, and specifications to ensure functional performance, regulatory compliance, durability, safety, and manufacturability.
  • Ability to analyze problems and provide design trade‑off analyses (performance, cost, weight, manufacturability, reliability) and documents rationale for design decisions.
  • Applies structured problem‑solving methods to resolve design issues, field failures, and manufacturing concerns.
  • Demonstrates strong engineering judgment and accountability for design quality and performance.

Design for Manufacturing, Cost, and Quality

  • Designs components optimized for high‑volume manufacturing, assembly efficiency, tooling capability, and supplier process constraints.
  • Partners with Sourcing and suppliers to evaluate manufacturing processes, tooling concepts, and cost drivers early in development.
  • Actively supports value engineering / cost‑down initiatives without compromising performance or quality.
  • Ensures designs comply with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and applicable UL / ANSI / CSA / ISO expectations.

Verification & Validation

  • Defines DFMEA inputs, design risks, and mitigation strategies for owned designs.
  • Develops and executes design verification plans including tolerance validation, stress analysis, durability testing, environmental testing, and abuse testing.
  • Uses data‑driven test results to refine designs and confirm requirements are met with appropriate margin.
  • Reviews and approves engineering changes, deviation requests, and corrective actions related to owned designs.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Works closely with Product Management to translate customer needs and CTQs into clear engineering requirements.
  • Supports Manufacturing Engineering during pilot builds, PPAP, and ramp‑up by resolving build issues and incorporating feedback into design revisions.
  • Collaborates with Quality, Compliance, and Reliability teams to support certifications, audits, and failure investigations.
  • Provides clear technical communication to global engineering, sourcing, and supplier teams.
  • Contributes to the development and improvement of design standards, test methods, and engineering processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of design experience in consumer, industrial, or electromechanical products.
  • Strong proficiency in 3D CAD (Creo / SolidWorks / NX or equivalent), detailed drawings, and GD&T.
  • Demonstrated experience with materials, manufacturing processes, tooling, and supplier‑built components.
  • Experience leading design verification and validation activities using data‑driven methods.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and technical communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, results‑driven product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, small engines, or high‑load electromechanical systems.
  • Hands‑on experience supporting pilot builds and production ramp‑ups.
  • Familiarity with global supplier collaboration and Asia‑based manufacturing.
  • Experience supporting UL / CSA / ANSI compliance activities.

Travel

  • Occasional travel (approximately 3–10%) to suppliers, manufacturing sites, or test facilities.

detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

FIELD SALES AND MARKETING REPRESENTATIVE – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:  

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provides TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this position, you will drive sales of our premier product lines within one of our largest retail partners. This position will allow you to enhance your selling, account management, and communication skills while launching your career in a fast-paced and extremely rewarding company.

Duties and Responsibilities:  

  • Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm
  • Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through
  • Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through
  • Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets— leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact
  • Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics
  • Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market
  • Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships
  • Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities
  • Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.


Job / Employment Requirements:  

  • Must be at least 21 years of age or older
  • Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions
  • Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening
  • Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state
  • Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation
  • Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver
  • Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required
  • Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies)
  • Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product
  • Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed
  • Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays
  • Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year
  • Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks
  • Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills  •     The applicant must be MS Office proficient
  • Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs
  • Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered
  • Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)
  • The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000
  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)
  • Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year
  • Company iPhone and iPad
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available
  • Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more
  • 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)
  • Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holidays (Based on hire date)
  • Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date
  • Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications as various positions are available nationwide. 

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at https://www.ttigroup.com/careers/us.

Your Role on Our Team: 

 

The Inventory Control Supervisor will assist the organization with inventory accuracy and tracking, item transition, allocation, demand planning and scheduling. The individual in this position will be responsible for supervising people conducting inventory functions including physical inventory, cycle counts, inventory adjustments, SKU relocation with utilizing a WMS, RF scanning and an ERP system. This position will help drive inventory accuracy, picking accuracy and efficiency by leading their team to manage the company’s inventory effectively. 

 

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:  

 

Empowered Leader: 

· Leads a team to manage the day-to-day operations and activities of facilities and programs effectively and efficiently in an assigned area.

· Works with manager to ensure appropriate staffing levels. 

· Sets schedules according to workload 

· Serves as a back-up in the absence of the Manager 

 

Candid: 

· Fosters a high degree of morale among associates, including providing feedback, recognition, and rewards.

· Provides timely, ongoing communication ensuring the appropriate dissemination of information to team leads and associates within the area. 

· Responsible for creating overall shift schedules and serving as back up for the Manager. 

· Final payroll approver in Kronos 

 

Always Improving: 

· Identifies measures that can improve various warehouse processes without the additional financial burden. 

· Develops all employees to become a valuable part of the team to ensure their skills are at par with warehouse standards and regulations. 

· Responsible for identifying and growing future team leaders within Milwaukee Tool. 

· Provides formal and informal feedback on an ongoing basis and leads the annual performance evaluation process to identify and develop talent. 

· Recommends employee corrective actions including recommendations for termination 

 

Obsessed: 

· Establishes operational strategy and related activities to facilitate consistent area goal achievement. 

· Maintains and enforces a clean and safe working environment. 

· Drives safety and culture and holds team members accountable for compliance including but not limited to adhering to safety incident reporting/protocols. 

 

Performs other duties as assigned. 

 

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you: 

 

· Unwavering focus on safety 

· Leadership experience and potential for future growth, able to coach on performance issues and discipline as necessary 

· Results-focused, takes ownership of team success 

· Strategically minded, able to assess team's needs and delegate effectively to exceed objectives 

· Exceptional communication skills, candid, able to delegate and manage the team successfully around multiple projects and priorities 

· Able to problem-solve quickly and execute solutions effectively 

· Has a development mindset, develops team for growth and is coachable. Continues to focus on their growth in the role to improve their skills 

· Exemplifies Culture 

 

Knowledge and Skills 

  • Detail-oriented, analytical with strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. 

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills 

  • Proficient at using a computer; above average skill in using web-based and Microsoft Office programs, particularly Excel 

  • Must have ability to comprehend procedures, systems and data. 

  • Solid understanding of inventory control functions and principles and how they impact processing orders and company financial targets. 

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple and changing priorities simultaneously. 

  • Self-starter with initiative. Must be able to execute tasks with minimal direct supervision. 

  • Bachelors of Business Administration or equivalent degree preferred, will accept strong work experience in place of a degree 

  • Experience working in inventory systems such as WMS systems, RF scan guns and ERP systems 

Working Conditions:  

 

​​Manufacturing​ 

· Frequent bending, stooping, pushing, and pulling of tools and boxes 

· Standing for long periods of time, as well as repetitive motion 

· Operate manual pallet jacks (Operation of other equipment is a plus!) 

· Able to work in various temperature conditions 

· Ability to lift and/or move objects up to 70lbs 

 

The physical and weightlifting demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

 

We provide these great perks and benefits:  

 

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans

detail.title: Oracle Sr Platform Analyst - Manufacturing & Inventory
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

INNOVATE without boundaries! 

Milwaukee Tool, an industry-leading manufacturer of heavy-duty power tools, accessories, and hand tools for professional users worldwide, is looking for a talented, enthusiastic, and motivated Sr Oracle Platform Analyst to help drive our manufacturing and inventory platforms forward. Come be a part of the IT team behind the most exciting and innovative tool company in the world and join the REDvolution! 

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to support the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. 

**Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

Your Role on Our Team:

As a Sr Oracle Platform Analyst - Manufacturing & Inventory, you are a senior Oracle Fusion practitioner who owns the functional health, design, and evolution of assigned Manufacturing and Inventory capabilities. You work hands-on within delivery to turn prioritized business capabilities into scalable, standardized Oracle solutions, favoring enterprise process patterns over unnecessary customization. You bring deep Oracle functional expertise, troubleshooting skill, and mentorship to the Oracle Platform Team, serving as a senior escalation point for complex platform issues.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities: 

  • Own the functional health and evolution of assigned Oracle Fusion Manufacturing and Inventory Management capabilities and Oracle Cost Management, proactively identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve the platform.
  • Champion standardized Oracle capabilities and enterprise process patterns, thoughtfully evaluating exceptions based on business value, scalability, and long-term platform sustainability.
  • Design and deliver scalable, reliable Oracle Fusion solutions while contributing to the architectural strategy and standards for Manufacturing and Inventory capabilities.
  • Configure Oracle Fusion hands-on across work definitions, work orders, production reporting, item and cost setup, on-hand balances, material movement, replenishment, and cycle counting, and support integrations to shop floor, warehouse, and planning systems.
  • Own assigned platform deliverables through design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
  • Partner with Product Owners, business process leaders, architects, Quality Engineering, and other delivery disciplines to translate prioritized capabilities into scalable Oracle solutions.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point and subject matter expert for complex Manufacturing, Inventory and Costing platform issues, driving root cause analysis through to durable resolution.
  • Assess Oracle Fusion quarterly releases and new capabilities, determining business impact, adoption opportunities, regression risk, and required platform changes.

  • Multiple years of hands-on experience configuring and supporting Oracle Fusion SCM Manufacturing and Inventory in a functional platform role.

  • Demonstrated functional solution and platform design capability, with the judgment to translate business needs into scalable, standardized Oracle capabilities rather than unnecessary customization.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex Oracle issues and perform root cause analysis across configuration, data, and integrated processes.
  • Working understanding of integrations between Oracle Fusion and connected shop floor, warehouse, and planning systems.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain Oracle capabilities, constraints, and tradeoffs to business and technical audiences across global teams.
  • Ability to operate independently as a senior practitioner, owning deliverables end to end and knowing when to escalate.
