detail.title: Maintenance Supervisor
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Maintenance Supervisor 1st shift Monday- Friday 6:00 AM-2:00 PM


At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success -- so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to provide… 

 

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to support the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.  

 

Your Role on Our Team: 

The Supervisor is responsible for directing and coaching employees. 

 

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:  

  • Leads a team to manage and support the day-to-day operations and activities of the facilities effectively and efficiently.  
  • Solicits feedback from Managers, Team Leads and associates related to performance and takes corrective action when needed.  
  • Leads in the recruitment, hiring, promoting, and terminating processes as needed.  
  • Works with manager to ensure appropriate staffing levels.  
  • Sets schedules according to workload  
  • Fosters a high degree of morale among associates, including providing feedback, recognition, and rewards.  
  • Conducts or delegates shift start-up meetings; communicates information related to culture, safety, production, accuracy, recognition, and facility/HR updates to keep team members informed  
  • Leads the performance review process and enters ratings in PEAK.  
  • Provides timely, ongoing communication ensuring the appropriate dissemination of information to department leaders.  
  • Prioritizes repairs needed to keep the facility at peak production.  
  • Responsible for creating overall shift schedules and serving as back up for the Manager.  
  • Final payroll approver in Kronos.  
  • Identifies measures that can improve various warehouse processes without the additional financial burden.  
  • Develops all technicians to become a valuable part of the team to ensure their skills are at par with warehouse standards and regulations.  
  • Responsible for identifying and growing future team leaders within Milwaukee Tool. 
  • provides formal and informal feedback on an ongoing basis and leads the annual performance evaluation process to identify and develop talent.  
  • Recommends employee corrective actions including recommendations for termination.  
  • Establishes operational strategy and related activities to facilitate consistent area goal achievement. 
  • Maintains and enforces a clean and safe working environment.  
  • Drives safety and culture and holds team members accountable for compliance including but not limited to adhering to safety incident reporting/protocols 
  • Develop a cohesive team of technicians that are committed to the success of the department.  
  • Communicate and support the other departments by support in their successes. 

 

 

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you: 

  • Requires education equivalent to four years of high school 
  • Unwavering focus on safety 
  • Leadership experience and potential for future growth, able to coach on performance issues and discipline as necessary  
  • Results-focused, takes ownership of team success  
  • Strategically minded, able to assess team's needs and delegate effectively to exceed objectives  
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and through email.  
  • Able to delegate and manage the team successfully around multiple projects and priorities  
  • Able to problem-solve quickly and execute solutions effectively

detail.title: Production Supervisor - 2nd Shift
detail.jobDescription:
Sup 2nd Shift

Job Description:

Milwaukee Tool – 2nd Shift Supervisor

Purpose of Position:

The Production Supervisor will oversee the production of our product through several phases performed internally and externally to meet on time delivery. They'll prioritize and schedule in-house production work orders using our MRP system, assist the Production Manager with monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts as well as ensure capacities are accurate internally and externally to meet forecasted demand.

The position reports to the Production Manager at Milwaukee Tool

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Schedule Work Orders needed for daily production requirements for various work cells
  • Maintaining production staff hours and schedules including logging attendance notes and managing time in software
  • Communicating and working with the HR department regarding production staff needs including temporary employee management, policy violations, conflict and evaluations
  • Provide performance feedback to Supervisors and Managers on team members as needed
  • Train new Production Team Leads
  • Communicate with Production Manager and Engineering as equipment and process issues exist internally and externally and require prompt resolution
  • Adheres to IB implemented safety standards including (PPE), work practice controls, and OSHA guidelines
  • Ensure proper costing of inventory through production processes
  • Oversee and communicate training of Leads and production staff on proper use of equipment
  • Work with the Safety Manger to ensure safety policies are being followed
  • Participate in continuous improvement efforts in support of lean processes and lead problem solving teams or kaizen events
  • Able to recognize and improve points of failure in the flow of production and implement countermeasures, escalate or recommend solutions
  • Oversee improvement of One-Piece Flow process in each work cell.
  • Help to implement KPI's and visual management tools on the production floor
  • Oversee the work cells are performing to best practices while keeping quality top priority
  • Responsible for order management and provides information to appropriate personnel, including the Team Leads, regarding needed changes and adjustments
  • Assist Production Manager with creation of monthly, quarterly and annual forecast
  • Understand daily work expectations and assist in assigning it to team members in which prioritizes the workload and equipment schedule to meet both internal and external demand
  • Effectively communicate with managers, engineers, technicians and necessary co-workers
  • Resolve schedule challenges as they arise by coordinating with necessary departments
  • Develop program to ensure standard of quality is met before all products leave facility
  • Maintain and apply Pareto principal practices used by Imperial Blades
  • Willingness to complete assigned special projects and other duties
  • Requests are completed with a good attitude and by needed deadlines

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Must have excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Possess ability to resolve problems, recognize normal and unusual situations
  • Ability to work with manual and/or power equipment and tools
  • Possess proven mechanical ability or aptitude
  • Demonstrates strong multitasking skills in a fast-paced environment
  • Accuracy and attention to detail required
  • Maintains a positive attitude and remains flexible to changing work environments
  • Is able to think independently, assign work to their team and work without direction
  • English skills to understand quality, safety, work instructions, personnel information, etc.
  • Microsoft Office proficiency including Outlook, Word and Excel
  • Ability to use ERP/MRP system (NetSuite a plus)

Education and/or Experience:

  • Production experience of 5 years minimum
  • Bachelor's degree in manufacturing management or equivalent experience
  • Previous supervisory experience and managing teams of employees
  • Experience with production scheduling
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing Principles
  • Experience with inventory costing concepts
  • Understanding of the Pareto principle and philosophy

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

  • The employee may be required to frequently lift, carry, push or pull up to 50 pounds
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
  • Frequent walking and sitting
  • Occasional bending, crouching, twisting, reaching
  • Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in certain work cells is required

detail.title: Assistant Mgr, Service NPD
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Milwaukee Tool’s service experience is a customer expectation and a competitive advantage.  The Assistant Mgr, Service NPD combines strong technical, project management, and cross-functional organizational skills to ensure that products in his/her portfolio are ready to be serviced upon their launch and remain “service-ready” throughout their lifecycle.  Working constantly with product engineering, marketing, international manufacturing, finance, and quality, as well as Service functions like spare parts, technical literature, and service center engineering, this role leads the execution of service-readiness in Service centers, branches, and authorized service centers, and also supports service readiness in global regions.

In addition to actual product projects, the Assistant Mgr, Service NPD helps create, implement, and improve the tools and processes needed to perform its functions. This job description lists major areas of responsibility.  Additional job duties and objectives may change with the business.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Create and own the global service-readiness plan, including key milestones and deadlines, to ensure products are service-ready across all customer touchpoints at launch.

  • Analyze sales forecasts, market trends, service demand, and regional business requirements to determine repair strategy recommendations by region.

  • Understand the underlying technology, service expectations, and competitive service landscape for existing and upcoming products in his/her portfolio.

  • Potential opportunities for exposure to new-to-Milwaukee and new-to-world products which would include creating all-new service programs and touchpoints.

  • Communicate and advocate for incorporating service needs into product designs.

  • Ensure readiness planning follows VIGOR and Service VIGOR, Milwaukee’s new product development standards.

  • Develop the repair and maintenance programs, including frequency, cost, complexity, and tooling and fixture needs.

  • Identify the spare parts and kits needed. Assist/guide the Tech Lit department in creating Spare Parts Lists. Assist planning and procurement departments in purchasing the correct spare parts in the right quantities at the right time, as needed.

  • Work with Quality and Engineering to develop repair SOPs, end of line tests, required tooling and fixturing, and quality collection regimens.

  • Design the technical and support literature strategy. Assist/guide the resources creating those documents, videos, and other support collateral, including what will be used for training.

  • Coordinate with Service commercial departments to ensure alignment with customer-facing programs and initiatives.

  • Work closely to coordinate and support readiness rollouts with repair hubs, factory service centers, authorized service centers, and global regions. Ensure these teams have been thoroughly advised of and engaged with projects in advance of launch, preventing surprises in support locations and poor customer experiences due to service un-readiness.

Education, Skills, and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or business degree is required, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years’ experience in designing, servicing, repairing, or reconditioning portable power tools or light equipment.
    • Experience with Milwaukee products is desired.
  • Demonstrated history of successful project or workflow management across a portfolio of dynamic, fast-moving projects.
  • Experience with the following is desired:
    • Product and tooling procurement
    • Designing and creating technical literature and videos
  • Solid communication skills, both written and verbal are required
  • Computer skills:
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Outlook)
    • Asana or similar Project Management application experience preferred.
    • Working in ERP/MRP environments.  Knowledge of Microsoft AX and/or Oracle is desired.
  • The successful candidate will demonstrate the following traits:
    • Highly deadline driven.
    • Strong attention to detail.
    • Problem solving, critical thinking, and analytics
    • Working cross functionally across a diverse and global organization.

Travel:

  • Occasional travel required, typically 10%-20%. Trips are typically domestic, <1 week duration, and suppliers. Employees must be willing to use the quickest and most cost-effective mode of transportation (Flight, Bus, Train, & etc.)

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Automation Engineer II - Mechatronics
detail.jobDescription:
Automation Engineer II

Job Description:

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success -- so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create innovative new solutions on our engineering team.   

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility. To learn more about the Milwaukee story and our company click HERE.  

Dept Engineering Overview: 

At Milwaukee Tool, Disruptive Innovation is not exclusive to the products introduced to the market; Disruptive Innovation is extended to all facets of the company including engineering support roles. As a team of Automation Engineers, we develop innovative automated test systems to support the validation of service repair work within our Service Hubs and Factory Service Centers. We work cross-functionally with Service Quality and Reliability Engineers, Service NPD Engineers, and Service Operations. We make empowered decisions to rapidly enhance reliability and confidence that your tool’s service repair operation is done correctly. Additionally, we support troubleshooting and design revisions to continuously improve existing systems. 

We are looking for engineers passionate about product testing, team collaboration, and automation. A typical Automation Engineer has vertical mechatronics skillsets including Electrical and Programming. While an engineer might specialize in one discipline, each engineer is expected to be agile across disciplines.  

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:    

Create and upkeep electrical schematics for system power, system safety, system measurements and physical panel layouts CAD 

  • Specify and approve system design stage uncertainty for all measurements devices included in the system design. 
  • Work with calibration vendor to verify uncertainty was upheld during integration 
  • Specify facilities power requirements for the system  
  • Conduct and approve impedance, filtering, amperage, power, voltage, and conversion calculations 
  • Develop equipment and test systems to support Service Hubs and Factory Service Centers. 
  • Integrate and troubleshoot physical hardware, sensors, and motion devices across domestic and global service centers. 
  • Drive discussion and scope surrounding system requirements in collaboration with Service NPD, Service QE/RE, and Service Operations. 
  • Create system documentation including BOM (bill of materials) and operational instructions. 
  • Work with vendors for procurement of BOM material, costing, and schedule.  
  • Analyze project risks and provide assessment to leadership  – included but not limited to: Cost, Schedule, Procurement, Design, and Safety. 
  • Prioritize and manage multiple projects - Adhere to timelines and excel in a fast-paced high-energy environment. 
  • Collaborate with other engineers in technical solutions and implementation across domestic and global service centers.  
  • Maintain technical competency and remain current in technology. 

Qualifications: 

  • Requires a bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical Engineering or related field. 
  • 2+ Years’ Experience in electrical design utilizing CAD 
  • Experience with root cause analysis tools (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA) 
  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles is a plus 
  • Hands on experience with building, integrating, and debugging industrial systems 
  • Ability to provide candid feedback to coworkers and leadership 
  • Willing to travel (15%) – Travel includes: Greenwood, IN, Greenwood, MS, Toronto, ON 

Preferred Skills: 

  • Exposure to ASANA, Solidworks Electrical, National Instruments is desirable 
  • Familiarity with ERP Systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) 
  • Mastery of test and measurement techniques, including sensor technology, signal conditioning, data acquisition and uncertainty calculations. 
  • Vast experience with industrial power systems – transformers, single/three phase power, machine panel layouts, DC power, safety devices, isolation, power conversion, digital and analog sensors/devices. 
  • Vast Experience with PLC Ladder Logic – Debug and New Development 

We provide these great perks and benefits:

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.
  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan.
  • Education assistance.
  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.
  • And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

rows.title: Field Sales & Marketing Representative - Kerrville, TX

detail.title: Field Sales & Marketing Representative - Kerrville, TX
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

FIELD SALES AND MARKETING REPRESENTATIVE – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provides TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Hart ®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this position, you will drive sales of our premier product lines within one of our largest retail partners. This position will allow you to enhance your selling, account management, and communication skills while launching your career in a fast-paced and extremely rewarding company.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm
  • Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through
  • Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through
  • Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact
  • Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics
  • Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market
  • Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships
  • Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities
  • Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

  • Must be at least 21 years of age or older
  • Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions
  • Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening
  • Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state
  • Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation
  • Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver
  • Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required
  • Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies)
  • Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product
  • Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed
  • Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays
  • Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year
  • Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks
  • Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills
  • The applicant must be MS Office proficient
  • Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs
  • Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered
  • Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)
  • The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000
  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)
  • Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year
  • Company iPhone and iPad
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available
  • Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more
  • 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)
  • Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holidays (Based on hire date)
  • Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date
  • Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

detail.title: Project Leader – New Product Development (NPD)
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

The Project Leader – New Product Development (NPD) is responsible for leading the overall execution of moderate to high complexity product development initiatives, with minimal oversight.  This role owns the technical scope, drives key design decisions and trade-off analyses, and coordinates cross-functional execution while maintaining full accountability for project delivery and cost.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drives overall project from concept to mass production, coordinating with cross-functional team and motivating them to accomplish project objectives.
  • Responsible for meeting cost, schedule, and performance targets during project execution.
  • Establishes and reinforces strong culture within project team.
  • Holds team members accountable for individual responsibilities during project.
  • Recognizes when escalation is needed, then effectively escalates to leadership.
  • Creates and tracks schedules and facilitates and documents project meetings.
  • Consistently visualizes entire scope of a project with very little guidance.
  • Effectively tracks project risks,
  • Leads tradeoff discussions with product management and other cross-functional team members.
  • Demonstrates effective negotiation skills to reach a compromise when needed.
  • Presents project updates, risks, and business cases to leadership.
  • Ensures component delivery via close coordination with US/Asia sourcing and supply chain teams.
  • Coordinates build readiness planning throughout the development process with cross-functional departments.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in related field
  • Strong understanding of electromechanical systems, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Results driven and deadline orientated. Ability to manage projects with extreme ownership to aggressive schedules and results. Ability to handle fast paced, and agile culture.  Ability to adapt to constant change and competing priorities. 
  • Excellent problem identification and resolution skills
  • Experience working on cross-functional teams.
  • Thrive in a collaborative work environment. Ability to develop and nurture productive business relationships, and influence and educate internal team members and external suppliers.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and project leadership skills.
  • 3-10% travel is required.

detail.title: Quality Engineer II
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one. 

 

Reporting to a Manager of Quality / Reliability, the Quality Engineer's primary responsibility is to support the successful launch of new products by driving manufacturing quality readiness, risk visibility, issue management, and cross-site alignment throughout the NPD lifecycle. Working with increasing levels of independence, the QE collaborates with Design Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, Supplier Quality, Operations, and global factory teams to identify manufacturing risks early, support readiness reviews, and help ensure quality concerns are effectively documented, communicated, and resolved. 

 

The QE serves as a quality liaison between domestic new product development teams and global manufacturing organizations, helping to ensure that supplier readiness, process controls, fixture readiness, documentation robustness, and production readiness activities are completed with appropriate visibility and alignment. The role offers opportunities to influence new product development, improve launch quality performance, and drive continuous improvement across global manufacturing operations. 

 

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Support creation, maintenance, and communication of NPD project quality readiness status, risks, issues, and closure plans.  

  • Assist in maintaining project Quality Readiness tracking and ensuring manufacturing quality risks are documented and communicated throughout the project lifecycle.  

  • Participate in supplier risk reviews, manufacturing risk reviews, PFMEA reviews, control plan reviews, and production readiness activities.  

  • Support development and alignment of production test plans, fixture readiness plans, process controls, and manufacturing quality documentation.

The Sr Electrical Engineer – Battery Electronics will lead the design and implementation of testing of embedded systems and identify engineering trends to drive strategies and Milwaukee Tool’s technical direction. You will work through the product development process in a team environment interacting with cross-functional stakeholders such as hardware, firmware, product development, and reliability engineers. This position will sit at our Headquarters located in Brookfield, Wisconsin.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:  

  • Execute a lead role for the design, prototype, test and troubleshoot embedded electronics hardware and firmware for mid to high complexity projects. 
  • Research and engage with prospective suppliers on selection of new technology including Lithium-Ion Battery Management ASICs, microcontrollers, Power Devices, and other analog and digital ICs. 
  • Provide expertise and engineering support on high complexity projects. 
  • Demonstrate Milwaukee Tools Culture of high performance and agility by independently creating Work Breakdown Structure for your work, driving to critical milestones, and giving candid communications up and down the organization on design progress and barrier removal. 
  • Use laboratory equipment to debug and develop your design with oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, spectrum analyzers, ESD/EMC, data acquisition systems, and analysis software. 
  • Effectively communicate and motivate up, down and across the organization to a diverse range of technical and non-technical team members.  
  • Drive urgency in project schedules and accountability for establishing and achieving key project metrics that meet the organization’s needs.  
  • Independently track projects to ensure adherence to schedule and the Milwaukee process. 

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
  • 5+ years of experience in the Embedded Electronics design field including 16/32 bit microcontroller-based circuits for measurement and power control. 
  • Demonstrated design experience in power management with ultra-low power embedded hardware and firmware implementations. 
  • Strong knowledge of industry best practices for design documentation, circuit simulation, schematic capture, layout, and prototype verification testing. 
  • Must be proficient in creation of firmware for purposes of technology evaluations/investigations. 
  • Proven ability to create a Work Breakdown Structure, drive to completion, and communicate progress and escalate barrier removal needs to management. 
  • Self-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic.   
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, exercises independent judgement and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment. 
  • Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international). 

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

  • Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
  • Previous PCBA design experience in Lithium-Ion Battery circuits for high volume products. 
  • Fundamental understanding of Lithium-Ion battery management strategies and circuits as well as familiarity with lithium-ion battery management ICs and vendors.

The Sr. Electrical Engineering Technician - Quality is a senior technical member of the Rapid Electronics Prototyping (REP) team. This role serves as the quality subject matter expert for prototype PCB assembly operations, ensuring electronic assemblies meet the highest standards of workmanship, reliability, and manufacturability. This position is responsible for programming and operating advanced inspection equipment, driving root cause investigations, providing DFM and process feedback to engineering teams, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the prototype manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate combines strong technical inspection skills with a passion for coaching others, solving complex manufacturing challenges, and elevating overall product quality.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:  

  • Program and operate advanced inspection equipment including AOI, X-Ray, SPI, and visual inspection systems to verify workmanship and compliance to IPC standards.
  • Serve as the primary quality expert for prototype PCB assembly processes, partnering with technicians, engineers, and designers to improve product quality and manufacturability.
  • Analyze assembly defects, inspection findings, and process trends to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
  • Provide real-time quality feedback and process recommendations to assembly personnel and engineering teams.
  • Conduct detailed inspections of PCB assemblies, solder joints, component placement, polarity, workmanship, and mechanical integration.
  • Perform and support rework, repair, and failure analysis activities using schematics, assembly documentation, and specialized rework equipment.
  • Collaborate with PCB Designers and Electrical Engineers to provide DFM, DFA, and assembly process recommendations early in the development cycle.
  • Provide training, coaching, and technical guidance to technicians and engineers on IPC standards, workmanship expectations, inspection techniques, and quality best practices.
  • Promote and maintain ESD, safety, and quality discipline throughout assembly and inspection operations.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Associate Degree from a two-year college or technical school. Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 5+ years of experience in electronics manufacturing
  • Strong knowledge of SMT, through-hole, and mixed-technology assembly processes.
  • Extensive understanding of IPC-A-610 and electronic assembly workmanship standards.
  • Experience programming and operating automated inspection equipment such as AOI, X-Ray, SPI, or related systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret schematics, assembly drawings, Gerber files, BOMs, and manufacturing documentation.
  • Strong understanding of component identification, package types, polarity, and electronic assembly best practices.
  • Ability to perform detailed inspections using microscopes and other inspection tools.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

  • IPC-A-610 certification.
  • Experience with Koh Young AOI/SPI systems.
  • Experience with electronic X-Ray inspection systems.
  • Knowledge of advanced rework techniques.
  • Experience supporting quality management systems and audit activities.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.
  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan.
  • Education assistance.
  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

The Electronics Test Engineer II will exhibit vision and foresight to test the extremes of designs to ensure robust and reliable electronic designs for Milwaukee power tools. detail.title: Field Sales and Marketing Representative - Marion, IL
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Field Sales and Marketing Representative – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.
  • Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.
  • Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.
  • Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.
  • Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.
  • Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.
  • Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.
  • Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

  • Must be at least 21 years of age or older.
  • Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.
  • Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.
  • Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.
  • Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.
  • Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.
  • Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.
  • Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).
  • Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.
  • Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.
  • Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.
  • Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.
  • Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.
  • Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.
  • The applicant must be MS Office proficient.
  • Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.
  • Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)
  • The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000
  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)
  • Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year
  • Company iPhone and iPad
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available
  • Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more
  • 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)
  • Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)
  • Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date
  • Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.
  • Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.
  • Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.
  • Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

  • Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

  • Must be at least 21 years of age or older.
  • Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.
  • Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.
  • Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.
  • Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.
  • Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.
  • Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.
  • Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).
  • Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.
  • Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.
  • Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.
  • Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.
  • Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.
  • Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.
  • The applicant must be MS Office proficient.
  • Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.
  • Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)
  • The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000
  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)
  • Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year
  • Company iPhone and iPad
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available
  • Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more
  • 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)
  • Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)
  • Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date
  • Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

As a Reliability Engineer II for Milwaukee Tool, you will be located at our Downtown Office Location in Milwaukee, WI reporting to the Reliability / Quality Manager. The Reliability Engineer II is a critical member of the Product Support and Value Engineering Team contributing intermediate to advanced engineering skills. Throughout a product's development cycle, this position requires strong cross-functional communication skills and analytical expertise to help maintain exciting solutions that meet user needs. You will work in a fast-paced environment to refine new products as a member of a cross-functional post-launch team.

Duties and Responsibilities

Product Development:

  • Lead teams for new product designs and engineering changes with respect to product reliability, user requirements and warranty information

  • Isolate and identify “critical to quality” (CtQ) user need requirements on mechanical and electrical design features; and all product component interactions

  • Track multiple projects simultaneously to ensure adherence to schedule and the Milwaukee Tool process.

  • Participate and collaborate on project teams involving Marketing and Engineering leading in all aspects of reliability and testing

Testing / Analysis:

  • Develop test plans and procedures based on new or established products, to ensure product meets customer requirements

  • Collaborate with test laboratories to implement test plans/procedures ensuring full test completion and best practices are utilized

  • Analyze, draw conclusions, report and present product information utilizing statistical techniques such as Weibull analysis, reliability distributions and matrices

  • 2-5+ years of experience in related reliability and quality field

  • Experience with new product commercialization processes emphasizing design, manufacturing, quality, test or reliability activities

  • Preferred: ASQ Reliability Engineering Certification (ASQ-CRE) or the ability and desire to achieve certification

  • Preferred: Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) or Six Sigma experience

Relevant internships, co-ops, research, and even hobbies may be factored into overall experience.
  • Experience with engineering design tools such as PCBA schematic/layout and circuit simulation software. Familiarity with embedded C development tools (IDEs, compilers, debuggers) is a big plus.

detail.title: Associate Quality Manager
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Wellford, SC location for an Associate Quality Manager.  The Associate Quality Manager supports the Quality Manager in maintaining and continually improving the company’s ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS) and overall quality performance. This position oversees daily quality activities, including incoming inspection, nonconforming material control, corrective actions, internal audits, product and process audits (as appropriate) and quality documentation / reporting.

We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

SCOPE

The Associate Quality Manager has direct responsibility for supervising Quality Technicians and coordinating temporary personnel and outside services supporting inspection, auditing, containment, sorting, and rework activities. The position works cross-functionally with Production, Quality Engineering, Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, Distribution and Logistics (as appropriate) to resolve quality issues, support audits, implement corrective actions, and promote consistent quality standards and continuous improvement throughout the organization, as appropriate.

WORK PERFORMED

  • Support the maintenance and continual improvement of the ISO 9001 Quality Management System.
  • Maintain and support quality procedures, work instructions, forms, and other controlled documentation.
  • Oversee and support incoming quality inspection activities at Distribution Centers and quality processes within production facilities, as required.
  • Ensure products, materials, and manufacturing processes meet established specifications, quality standards, and acceptance requirements.
  • Manage the identification, containment, and disposition of nonconforming materials.
  • Coordinate temporary personnel and outside services for inspection, sorting, containment, and rework projects.
  • Support internal audits, ISO certification audits, and other quality system assessments.
  • Document audit findings and support corrective action development, implementation, and effectiveness verification.
  • Support root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor quality performance and identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support preparation for Management Review and other QMS-related activities.
  • Perform other quality-related duties and projects, as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Associate’s degree in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of Quality Assurance or Quality Control experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management System requirements.
  • ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification a plus.
  • Experience with manufacturing processes, incoming inspection, nonconforming material control, corrective actions, root cause analysis, and internal auditing.
  • Previous supervisory or team leadership experience preferred.
  • Experience working with domestic and international manufacturing operations is preferred.

Job Description:

About Us:  

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provides TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this position, you will drive sales of our premier product lines within one of our largest retail partners. This position will allow you to enhance your selling, account management, and communication skills while launching your career in a fast-paced and extremely rewarding company.

Duties and Responsibilities:  

  • Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm
  • Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through
  • Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through
  • Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets— leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact

  • Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market

  • Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product

  • Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks

  • Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)
  • The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000
  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

To learn more about the Milwaukee story and our company click HERE.

  

You'll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

  • The primary role of this position is to create prototype components using the latest software and machining methodology, in support of new product development.
  • Work directly from CAD Models, sketches and verbal instructions to produce accurate prototype power tool components in a variety of materials.
  • Program and post to a variety of CNC equipment using CAD/CAM software for a variety of complex models, dies, plastic injection molds, hydraulic components and gears.
  • Recommend design changes or modifications, select allowances and materials, proceed from own concept in the absence of design and specifications as needed.
  • Use a variety of precision measuring devices to layout and inspect work.
  • This position requires a highly skilled / motivated individual who will be required to frequently communication with our New Product Development Team and maintain schedules in conjunction with safety and quality.

What TOOLS you'll bring with you:

  • Requires a high school education or equivalent supplemented by an apprenticeship program and 10+ years of applied experience in related fields. Apprenticeship requirement can be offset by work experience.
  • A thorough understanding of commonly used machining principles, i.e. Datum planes, tab machining, dimensional accuracy and materials.
  • Extensive programming and operational knowledge in one or more of the following machines.
  • Hermle Five Axis Mill, Haas / Fadal / Mazak Vertical Machining Center, Mazak Multi-Tasking Integrex/ Nexus CNC Turning, Mitsubishi EDM, Sodick Sinker / EDM Wire, Koepfer Gear Hob, Knee Mills and ID / OD Grinders
  • Proficiency in Cad / Cam software is essential to perform assigned responsibilities. CAD proficiency in one or more of the following; Solid Works, NX Unigraphics, CAM programming proficiency in Power Mill Virtual Gibbs, NX Unigraphics, Master Cam or SurfCam software required.

 We provide these great perks and benefits:

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.
  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan.
  • Education assistance.
  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food and coffee service.
  • And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Automation Engineer II-Mechatronics
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Company Engineering Overview: 

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! - At Milwaukee Tool, we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success. Our Engineering teams are key contributors to continuous innovation, delivering disruptive technologies through direct engagement with end users and cross-functional collaboration. We create best-in-class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes, and a commitment to continuous improvement. 

Dept Engineering Overview: 

Create test solutions for Tomorrow’s Tools. At Milwaukee Tool, disruptive innovation extends beyond the products we bring to market. As a member of the Test Automation Group (TAG), you will develop innovative automated test systems that support new product development across North America and our global laboratories. You will work cross-functionally with New Product Development, Reliability, Quality, and Laboratory teams to define requirements, develop solutions, and drive automation projects from concept through deployment. 

The Automation Engineer II is a capable technical contributor who develops automated test solutions with growing ownership and independence. This individual applies knowledge of TAG, Lab, and NPD processes to make sound design decisions, recognizes project schedule and design risks early, and proactively communicates obstacles with potential solutions. They collaborate effectively with cross-functional and global partners, receive design feedback constructively, begin providing relevant design guidance to others, and continue building technical depth, project execution capability, and productive team relationships. 

 

Be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:    

 

Overall: 

  • Develop automated test systems to support new product development, with growing ownership of project scope, requirements, design, build, integration, and deployment activities. 

  • Integrate and troubleshoot physical hardware, sensors, measurement devices, safety systems, and motion devices across domestic and global test labs. 

  • Support project scope discussions and system requirements development in collaboration with New Product Development, Test Lab, Reliability Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders. 

  • Interpret project charters and leverage project objectives to support engineering decisions.  

  • Create and maintain system documentation including BOMs, operating instructions, risk assessments, validation documentation, and design review materials. 

  • Partner with vendors for system procurement, technical collaboration, costing, and schedule management. 

  • Analyze project risks and communicate concerns related to cost, schedule, procurement, design maturity, quality, and safety.  

  • Proactively escalate project obstacles and roadblocks while bringing potential solutions and mitigation options to stakeholders. 

  • Prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, communication, and execution discipline. 

  • Apply structured problem-solving and root cause analysis methods to troubleshoot issues and evaluate alternative solutions. 

  • Demonstrate ownership of project success through proactive communication, risk awareness, follow-through, and data-supported recommendations. 

  • Enhance technical competency and skills by seeking growth opportunities that improve individual efficiency and project execution. 

Mechanical (Ideal candidate has a blend of electrical and mechanical skills) 

  • Create and maintain CAD models and drawings for system assemblies, components, fixtures, and products. 

  • Perform engineering calculations and analysis for mechanical components and assemblies, including static, force, torque, inertial, energy, and basic FEA evaluations. 

  • Specify materials, surface finishes, heat treatments, and coatings based on application needs, stresses, wear, and tolerances, with support as needed for higher-complexity decisions. 

  • Integrate mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and electrical subsystems into automated test platforms. 

  • Work collaboratively with designers, technicians, machinists, vendors, and cross-functional teams throughout design, fabrication, integration, and deployment. 

 

Electrical (Ideal candidate has a blend of electrical and mechanical skills) 

  • Create and maintain electrical schematics for system power, safety circuits, measurement systems, controls, and physical panel layouts. 

  • Evaluate measurement devices to ensure optimized measurement uncertainty.  

  • Collaborate with calibration service providers to validate system measurement performance. 

  • Perform calculations involving power distribution, filtering, signal conditioning, current capacity, power conversion, grounding, and electrical safety.  

  • Support PLC, HMI, motion control, data acquisition, and industrial communication system development, troubleshooting, and validation.  

  • Support electrical design reviews and provide constructive technical feedback related to measurement systems, industrial controls, and electrical architecture. 

 

Technical Collaboration and Project Ownership 

  • Serve as a dependable technical contributor on medium-complexity automation projects.  

  • Drive assigned project work with minimal guidance while maintaining alignment with project scope, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.  

  • Provide constructive design feedback and technical guidance to peers during design reviews and project discussions.  

  • Collaborate with teams internally and cross-functionally to solve problems.  

  • Communicate project status, technical risks, design tradeoffs, and recommended next steps clearly to stakeholders.  

  • Use TAG, laboratory, and NPD processes to support project execution, design maturity, and validation planning.  

  • Contribute to engineering best practices, design standards, documentation templates, and automation methodologies.  

  • Support a culture of continuous learning, accountability, innovation, and technical excellence. 

 

What SUCCESS looks like: 

A successful Automation Engineer II: 

  • Independently drives automation projects from concept through deployment while balancing scope, quality, schedule, and cost.  

  • Proactively identifies risks, communicates roadblocks early, and brings data-supported solutions to stakeholders.  

  • Builds strong relationships across Product Engineering, Reliability, Laboratory, Vendor, and Global teams to achieve project objectives.  

  • Applies sound engineering judgment and structured problem-solving to deliver robust, innovative test solutions.  

  • Continuously improves technical capabilities, engineering processes, and team effectiveness while growing as a technical leader. 

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Design Engineer II
detail.jobDescription:
Design Engineer II

Job Description:

As a Design Engineer II for Milwaukee you will be located at our Brookfield, WI office. Our corporate office is only 15 minutes from downtown Milwaukee and located near Miller Park, Milwaukee Zoo, Mitchell Park Domes, as well as many more attractions and restaurants. 

 

You will work in a fast-paced environment to innovate new products as a member of a cross-functional team. One of the most rewarding aspects of the job is seeing a product you designed on the shelves of a Home Depot. 

 

If you are interested in travel, domestic and international travel opportunities are available and sometimes required. In the US, Milwaukee Tool has three locations in Mississippi (two manufacturing and one distribution). Overseas, you will have the opportunity to work with Chinese engineering counterparts as well as meet with suppliers in both Taiwan and China. 

 

Milwaukee offers benefits on your first day of work including health, dental, vision, life insurance and 401k. Milwaukee also provides an excellent working environment that includes an on-site cafeteria, state of the art fitness facility, recreational sports leagues and company outings. 

 

Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Take a concept idea and make it come to life. 

  • Design and test products from concept to production. 

  • Develop design solutions to meet consumer requirements. 

  • Participate in field research. 

  • Facilitate project flow involving regular contact with manufacturing and other cross-functional team members. 

  • Interact with suppliers to develop part/product specifications that meet performance requirements while falling within process capabilities. 

  • Evaluate product design relative to material selection, cost and reliability. 

  • Perform a wide variety of calculations and software aided analyses in the following areas: 

  • Mechanical stress analysis, material and heat treatment selection, tolerance and fit analyses, lubrication, spur and helical gear design, statics and dynamics, noise and vibration and a variety of machine element design. 

  • Independently develop, write and analyze test requests with the Milwaukee Tool Test Laboratory. 

  • Work as a technical resource to troubleshoot problems with manufacturing teams and suppliers. 

 

Education and Experience Requirements 

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering; or similar field. 

  • 2+ years of experience in related design field. 

  • Experience in participating or leading cross functional team meetings  

  • GD & T and CAD proficiency 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands-on attitude. 

  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel and Power Point. 

  • Willingness to learn skill sets outside primary discipline. 

  • Ability to travel 10% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International). 

  • High interest in tools of the trade. 

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

Design Engineer II – Power Tools

 

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence. 

 

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. 

 

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE. 

 

As a Design Engineer II for Milwaukee you will be located at our Brookfield, WI office. Our corporate office is only 15 minutes from downtown Milwaukee and located near Miller Park, Milwaukee Zoo, Mitchell Park Domes, as well as many more attractions and restaurants.  

 

You will work in a fast-paced environment to innovate new products as a member of a cross-functional team. One of the most rewarding aspects of the job is seeing a product you designed on the shelves of a Home Depot.  

 

If you are interested in travel, domestic and international travel opportunities are available and sometimes required. In the US, Milwaukee Tool has three locations in Mississippi (two manufacturing and one distribution). Overseas, you will have the opportunity to work with Chinese engineering counterparts as well as meet with suppliers in both Taiwan and China.  
 
Milwaukee Electric Tool offers benefits on your first day of work (health, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k) and an excellent working environment that includes an on-site cafeteria as well as a state of the art fitness facility! 

 

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities: 

  • Take a concept idea and make it come to life.  

  • Design and test products from concept to production.  

  • Develop design solutions to meet consumer requirements.  

  • Participate in field research.  

  • Facilitate project flow involving regular contact with manufacturing and other cross-functional team members.  

  • Interact with suppliers to develop part/product specifications that meet performance requirements while falling within process capabilities.  

  • Evaluate product design relative to material selection, cost and reliability.  

  • Perform a wide variety of calculations and software aided analyses in the following areas:  

  • Mechanical stress analysis, material and heat treatment selection, tolerance and fit analyses, lubrication, spur and helical gear design, statics and dynamics, noise and vibration and a variety of machine element design.  

  • Independently develop, write and analyze test requests with the Milwaukee Tool Test Laboratory.  

  • Work as a technical resource to troubleshoot problems with manufacturing teams and suppliers.  

 

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you: 

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering; or similar field.  

  • 2+ years of experience in related design field.  

  • Experience in participating or leading cross functional team meetings   

  • GD & T and CAD proficiency  

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands-on attitude.  

  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel and Power Point.  

  • Willingness to learn skill sets outside primary discipline.  

  • Ability to travel 10% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International).  

  • High interest in tools of the trade.  

 

We provide these great perks and benefits: 

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans. 

  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan. 

  • Education assistance. 

  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service. 

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.
