detail.title: Design Engineer II, Front End Innovation
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

DRIVEN TO SET THE STANDARD.

At Milwaukee Tool, we strive to be the best—delivering new-to-Milwaukee and truly disruptive innovations that redefine what’s possible for our users. Our people and our culture are the foundation of our success. In Fastening Power Tools NPD, you’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team where technical excellence, analytical leadership, and continuous learning are celebrated. Every day, you’ll be empowered to own your work, drive breakthrough solutions, and help shape the future of fastening technology.

We invest in our people, providing the resources, trust, and support needed to grow, learn, and make an impact. Our commitment to teamwork and technical rigor ensures every developmental phase happens in-house, guided by passionate engineers who push the boundaries of innovation. Year after year, we deliver industry-leading advancements and we’re just getting started.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead technical resource on mid/high complexity Power Tool New Product Development projects.
  • Provide clear technical information to cross functional teammates, Project Leaders and Global Engineering teams, facilitating trade-off decisions.
  • Establish test regimens for components and assemblies within project scope with minimal guidance; deliver complete data analysis to support design recommendations.
  • Serve as a technical resource and provide consultation/mentorship to engineering and non-engineering teammates alike.
  • Apply first principles to create free body diagrams and develop static and/or dynamic models of new systems, leading the design analytically and supporting decision-making through rigorous engineering analysis.
  • Perform mechanical stress analysis on linear and non-linear systems.
  • Conduct root cause analysis to identify and resolve technical challenges.
  • Execute tolerance stack analyses (statistical and geometric preferred).
  • Design and analyze gear-driven systems and mechanisms, including sound and vibration/response of dynamic systems.
  • Demonstrate system-level thinking by maintaining a holistic view of how interdisciplinary design decisions affect user needs and project delivery.
  • Collaborate proactively with interdisciplinary peers to plan for and address issues that could impact schedule, cost, performance, or delivery of user needs.
  • Create and execute plans to inform early-stage development using both empirical and analytical methods; develop structured approaches to investigate root cause and troubleshoot designs under cost, schedule, performance, and other constraints.
  • Operate effectively in a high-paced and dynamic development environment.
  • Motivate and support learning—actively seek opportunities to learn and teach others about new discoveries and best practices.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering
  • 5 years of machine design experience, minimum
  • Strong proficiency in 3D CAD Modeling
  • Deep mechanical aptitude is required including a broad knowledge of engineering materials, machine component design, mechanical properties and an understanding of the manufacturing processes associated with these materials.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 10% (travel includes Domestic and International).
  • Genuine interest in tools of the construction trades and a passion for innovative product development.
  • Strong motivation to grow, learn, and be challenged by the unknown
  • Experience in systems where closed-loop performance, accuracy, and repeatability are critical (e.g., robotics, automated assembly, precision torque/control systems).
  • Strong foundation in process control and applied statistics, including capability metrics, variation reduction, and experimental design.
  • Ability to think at the system level by showing an understanding how hardware, controls, and user/environmental inputs interact to influence performance consistency.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • 401(k) savings program with immediate vesting.
  • Education assistance to support your ongoing growth.
  • On-site wellness resources, including a fitness center, cafeteria, complimentary coffee, and more.
  • Patent Award Program to recognize and reward innovation.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Field Sales and Marketing Representative - Bellingham, MA
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Field Sales and Marketing Representative – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.
  • Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.
  • Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.
  • Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.
  • Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.
  • Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.
  • Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.
  • Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

  • Must be at least 21 years of age or older.
  • Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.
  • Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.
  • Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.
  • Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.
  • Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.
  • Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.
  • Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).
  • Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.
  • Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.
  • Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.
  • Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.
  • Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.
  • Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.
  • The applicant must be MS Office proficient.
  • Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.
  • Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)
  • The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000
  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)
  • Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year
  • Company iPhone and iPad
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available
  • Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more
  • 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)
  • Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)
  • Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date
  • Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

As a Project Engineer for Milwaukee your primary focus would be to contribute to the support of Milwaukee’s corded and cordless products. In this role, you would report directly to the Sr. Manager in Engineering.
 
As a Project Engineer for Milwaukee you will be utilizing your engineering skills and project management ability to execute design changes, derivative tool releases and general maintenance of existing products.  
 
Milwaukee Electric Tool offers benefits on your first day of work (health, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k) and an excellent working environment that includes an on-site cafeteria as well as a state of the art fitness facility!
 
Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Leads small to medium scale engineering projects for Product Support, Warranty & derivative products. Provides engineering support on mid-level complexity projects under the supervision of department manager.

  • Work cross-functionally and globally with Quality & Reliability Engineering, Purchasing, Finance, Service & Support, Marketing, and numerous other departments.

  • Evaluate product designs relative to the selection, cost and resolution of problems associated with materials, heat treatment and finishes.  Work cross functionally with advanced engineering teams.

  • Regularly visit the manufacturing cells/suppliers to maintain open lines of communication with the cell/suppliers and provide troubleshooting analysis as required.

  • Track warranty activity and initiate corrective action.

  • Request and perform tests per established procedures. 

Interpret data and make corresponding design changes including but not limited to:

  • Utilization of computer aided simulation tools

  • Stress analysis

  • Selection of materials and heat treatments

  • Tolerance stacks and deviation analysis

  • Selection and evaluation of lubricant properties and uses

  • Statics and dynamics

  • Noise and vibration analysis

  • Interact with suppliers to develop part and product specifications that meet performance requirements while falling within process capabilities.

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or educational equivalent is required. Preferred degree in Mechanical Engineering.

  • 2+ years of relevant working experience.

  • Ability to travel to China & domestically several times of year is required (15% travel).

  • Ability to manage several simultaneous projects is required.

  • Highly developed Mechanical/Electrical aptitude is required including a broad knowledge of engineering materials used in small appliances or power tools, and an understanding of the manufacturing processes associated with these materials.

  • Ability to use CAD is required. Unigraphics or ProE are preferred.

  • To be successful in this role you will need to be a self-starter who has a strong problem solving skill set and understands design, testing, and manufacturing processes (grinding, stamping, heat treatment, functional coatings, machining, etc).

  • Able to provide a basic overview of upcoming workload and identify potential resoure bottlenecks.

  • Basic understanding of various cost drivers associated with materials, labor & overhead is required.

  • PMP certification is a plus but not required.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Senior Design Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

DRIVEN TO SET THE STANDARD. 

At Milwaukee Tool, we strive to be the best—delivering new-to-Milwaukee and truly disruptive innovations that redefine what’s possible for our users. Our people and our culture are the foundation of our success. In Fastening Power Tools NPD, you’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team where technical excellence, analytical leadership, and continuous learning are celebrated. Every day, you’ll be empowered to own your work, drive breakthrough solutions, and help shape the future of fastening technology. 

We invest in our people, providing the resources, trust, and support needed to grow, learn, and make an impact. Our commitment to teamwork and technical rigor ensures every developmental phase happens in-house, guided by passionate engineers who push the boundaries of innovation. Year after year, we deliver industry-leading advancements and we’re just getting started. 

Duties & Responsibilities 

  • Lead technical resource on mid/high complexity Power Tool New Product Development projects.  

  • Provide clear technical information to cross functional teammates, Project Leaders and Global Engineering teams, facilitating trade-off decisions.  

  • Establish test regimens for components and assemblies within project scope with minimal guidance; deliver complete data analysis to support design recommendations.  

  • Serve as a technical resource and provide consultation/mentorship to engineering and non-engineering teammates alike.  

  • Apply first principles to create free body diagrams and develop static and/or dynamic models of new systems, leading the design analytically and supporting decision-making through rigorous engineering analysis.  

  • Perform mechanical stress analysis on linear and non-linear systems.  

  • Conduct root cause analysis to identify and resolve technical challenges.  

  • Execute tolerance stack analyses (statistical and geometric preferred).  

  • Design and analyze gear-driven systems and mechanisms, including sound and vibration/response of dynamic systems.  

  • Demonstrate system-level thinking by maintaining a holistic view of how interdisciplinary design decisions affect user needs and project delivery.  

  • Collaborate proactively with interdisciplinary peers to plan for and address issues that could impact schedule, cost, performance, or delivery of user needs.  

  • Create and execute plans to inform early-stage development using both empirical and analytical methods; develop structured approaches to investigate root cause and troubleshoot designs under cost, schedule, performance, and other constraints.  

  • Operate effectively in a high-paced and dynamic development environment.  

  • Motivate and support learning—actively seek opportunities to learn and teach others about new discoveries and best practices. 

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you: 

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering 

  • 5 years of machine design experience, minimum 

  • Strong proficiency in 3D CAD Modeling 

  • Deep mechanical aptitude is required including a broad knowledge of engineering materials, machine component design, mechanical properties and an understanding of the manufacturing processes associated with these materials. 

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 10% (travel includes Domestic and International). 

  • Genuine interest in tools of the construction trades and a passion for innovative product development. 

  • Strong motivation to grow, learn, and be challenged by the unknown 

  • Experience in systems where closed-loop performance, accuracy, and repeatability are critical (e.g., robotics, automated assembly, precision torque/control systems). 

  • Strong foundation in process control and applied statistics, including capability metrics, variation reduction, and experimental design. 

  • Ability to think at the system level by showing an understanding how hardware, controls, and user/environmental inputs interact to influence performance consistency. 

Benefits 

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.  

  • 401(k) savings program with immediate vesting.  

  • Education assistance to support your ongoing growth.  

  • On-site wellness resources, including a fitness center, cafeteria, complimentary coffee, and more.  

  • Patent Award Program to recognize and reward innovation. 

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Vibration Simulation & FEA Engineer II
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Vibration Simulation / FEA Engineer – Advanced Battery Simulation

We are seeking a Vibration Simulation / FEA Engineer to support the development and virtual validation of structures, mechanisms, and components for batteries. This role will focus on using finite element analysis (FEA), vibration simulation, modal analysis, and dynamic analysis to predict structural behavior, identify potential vibration and durability issues, wear, thermal fatigue, optimize designs, and improve product reliability.

The engineer will work closely with design, test, reliability, and product development teams throughout the product development cycle. The successful candidate will translate product requirements and real-world operating conditions into appropriate simulation models and loading criteria, correlate simulation results with physical test data, and provide actionable recommendations to improve product performance, durability, reliability, and cost.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities

  • Develop and execute FEA simulations for structural and vibration performance of components, assemblies, and complete systems.
  • Perform modal analysis, including prediction and evaluation of natural frequencies, mode shapes, and structural resonance.
  • Conduct dynamic simulations such as frequency response, harmonic response, random vibration, transient response, and shock analysis as applicable to product requirements.
  • Evaluate structural response to operational vibration environments and identify potential resonance, amplification, fatigue, and durability concerns.
  • Perform linear and nonlinear FEA to evaluate structural behavior under static and dynamic loading conditions.
  • Develop appropriate finite element models, including mesh generation, material properties, boundary conditions, contacts, joints, and loading conditions.
  • Define and apply vibration and structural loading criteria based on product requirements, customer usage, field data, and physical testing.
  • Analyze vibration test data, including time-domain and frequency-domain data, to develop representative simulation inputs and validate analytical predictions.
  • Support random vibration analysis, including interpretation and application of PSD-based loading where appropriate.
  • Evaluate vibration-induced stresses and responses and perform fatigue and durability assessments using simulation results and measured operating data.
  • Correlate simulation results with modal testing, shaker testing, field testing, and other physical validation data.
  • Work closely with the test team to develop appropriate test methods, instrumentation strategies, excitation profiles, and performance criteria.
  • Investigate discrepancies between simulation and physical test results and improve FEA models and assumptions to achieve meaningful correlation.
  • Support troubleshooting of vibration, noise, structural, and durability issues identified during development and validation testing.
  • Perform design optimization to improve structural stiffness, mass, natural frequency separation, durability, and overall product performance.
  • Continuously improve simulation methods, modeling practices, and FEA/test correlation processes.
  • Partner with design engineers to refine structural concepts and develop robust designs that meet performance, reliability, cost, and timing objectives.
  • Develop, maintain, and release FEA models, vibration analysis reports, loading criteria, simulation methodologies, and technical documentation.
  • Support product development teams in resolving structural and vibration issues while maintaining program development schedules.
  • Assist with processing and interpretation of laboratory and field vibration data to establish realistic durability and loading criteria.
  • Work closely with NPD (New Product Development), Test & Validation Engineering, Reliability & Durability Engineering, and Marketing.
  • Communicate simulation results and engineering recommendations clearly to design and test teams.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional product development environment.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering
  • 3+ years of Finite Element Analysis (FEA) experience
  • 3+ years of prior work experience in design or product validation environment.
  • doing mechanical design or validation, proficient in a CAD software package
  • 3+ years of prior work experience in nonlinear FEA and fatigue analysis
  • 3+ years of prior work experience with the following: Ansys, Abaqus and Abaqus Explicit FEA software, Hypermesh, and Optistruct software, Fatigue Software such as nCode, Mechanical principles, kinematics, structural materials, and standard machine and mechanism components.
  • Knowledgeable in CAD – NX, Solidworks, or similar

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Concept Designer
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Come join the team at Techtronic Industries, the world leader in cordless technology spanning Power Tools, Outdoor Power Equipment, Floor Care Appliances and Accessories. We currently have an open Engineering position in the Advanced Concepts group at our Anderson, SC office.

Advanced Concepts is an interdisciplinary innovation group of designers and engineers within the Power Tool division, tasked with developing cutting-edge concepts for brands such as RYOBI and RIDGID. You will work hand and hand with other Advanced Concepts team members, as well as engineering, industrial design, analytical, and project management groups to deliver functional prototypes that can be evaluated for feasibility or concept recommendations that can be used for later product development. Your day-to-day activities will include: brainstorms, designing and building prototypes, feasibility testing, and concept refinement. We are a very hands-on group that thrives on learning throughout our diverse projects to create new and innovative products.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Ideate and create prototypes that demonstrate future solutions for future product needs.
  • Ideate and create demos showcasing our products’ performance and features
  • Work with cross functional team that includes, Industrial Designers, Mechanical and Electrical Engineers
  • Build and Manage budget, schedule, and quality expectations to meet key milestones
  • Communicate technical details and concepts to both technical and non-technical team members

Qualifications:

  • B.S. in Mechanical or B.A. in Industrial Design
  • 0 - 3 years’ experience in design, prototyping, and/or test fixture development
  • 3D CAD experience
  • Experience with hands-on fabrication methodologies (3D printing, woodworking, metal working)
  • Experience with electronics including Arduino and Raspberry PI is a plus.
  • Understanding of key performance metrics such as power, speed, and torque.
  • Experience with measurement equipment for vibration & sound is a plus
  • An eye for aesthetically pleasing designs is a plus.

Software
Office, NX, SolidWorks, Altium, Photoshop, Microsoft Project

We Value:

  • Self-starters who can work well autonomously and in collaboration with teams
  • Individuals with the “Maker” mindset – excited to jump into a new project and not afraid to get their hands dirty
  • Collaborative contributors – bring outside experience and interests to brainstorms
  • Cross-functional communicators – able to translate information between technical and non-technical co-workers, in Anderson and internationally
  • Experience with Rapid Prototyping (varying materials and processes)
  • Familiarity with electrical and mechanical systems (ex. motors, microcontrollers, batteries)

detail.title: Machine Learning Engineer II
detail.jobDescription:
Machine Learning Engineer

Job Description:

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Your role on our team

As a Machine Learning Engineer II, you will create, develop, and validate machine learning models while working with highly cross-functional teams to make power tool solutions that change the lives of our users. You will innovate and explore new machine learning solutions to deploy into Milwaukee products around the world while demonstrating excellent problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and the ability to thrive under pressure in a dynamic environment. Success in this role also requires strong technical communication skills and fundamental project management abilities, along with a proactive sense of ownership for projects and tasks and an understanding of how they connect to broader initiatives.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or other scientific or engineering discipline.

  • Completed course work or specialization in Machine Learning and/or Data Science

  • At least one year of hands-on experience applying machine learning principles and algorithms involving embedded systems, edge computing, signal processing or a related field

  • Demonstrated experience applying fundamental machine learning algorithms and techniques in a non-coursework setting (e.g. unsupervised or supervised learning, classification/regression, dimensionality reduction, model optimization)

  • Demonstrated experience with machine learning and AI methods such as CNNS, transformers, or computer vision

  • Proficient developing and debugging code in Python

  • Proficiency in Python, with extensive experience in common libraries (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, etc.)

  • Proficiency with at least one deep learning framework (e.g. PyTorch of Tensor Flow)

  • Sold mathematical foundation in statistics, linear algebra, calculus and optimization

  • Experience working with modern software development tools and version control tools

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and ability to work well under pressure in a dynamic environment.

  • Excellent technical communication skills and fundamental project management abilities

  • Demonstrated strong sense of ownership of a project or tasks and understanding of relationships to other tasks/projects

  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time (domestic and international).

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Machine Learning or related field is preferred

  • At least three years of hands-on experience applying machine learning principles and algorithms involving embedded systems, edge computing, signal processing or a related field (an advanced degree may count toward some experience)

  • Experience with time series modelling, especially with related domains such as NLP, SLAM, forecasting, or audio/video processing

  • Proven track record of developing, deploying and implementing AI or ML solutions connected to business objectives

  • Proficient developing and debugging code in an embedded environment in a programming language such as C or C++

  • Working knowledge of various sensor technologies (e.g. IMU, thermistors, magnetic and optical) and interfacing to microcontrollers

  • Working knowledge of embedded systems architecture (HW & SW), microcontroller design and operation

  • Experience with different types of data collection methods, understanding their principles and demonstrating their value in relevant environments

  • Experience developing and deploying machine learning algorithms to edge environments

  • Demonstrated ability to develop robust MLOps pipelines and ensure efficient deployment, monitoring and scaling of ML models

We provide these great perks and benefits:

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.

  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan.

  • Education assistance.

  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

  • And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Machine Maintenance Technician
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening for Machine Maintenance Technician - Night Shift, in its Anderson, SC location, that will support a large-scale distribution center. We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation, and holiday. The level of the position will be based on experience and knowledge of the job requirements.

Responsibilities include but not limited to

  • Ability to read and understand manufacturer's instructions, engineering specifications, sketches, operation manuals, and diagrams to diagnose and troubleshoot abnormalities.

  • Inspect broken or defective machines and parts and recommend repair requirements to the manager.

  • Excellent general understanding of machine and robot automation with display of mastery in troubleshooting by utilizing deductive reasoning and schematics.

  • Complete preventive maintenance prerequisites on mechanical equipment like motors, conveyors, production machines, pneumatic tools, and engines to ensure smooth operation of such machinery and mechanical gadgets.

  • Perform troubleshooting tasks and repair works on complex industrial machines.

  • Ensure cleanliness of machine and machine components by making use of a broom, air guns, solvents, cloths, vacuum, or other appliances.

  • Disassemble machines and take off parts for replacement or repair by using cranes, hoists, chain falls, hand tools, and jacks.

  • Replace, fix, or realign machine parts and accessories in line with production specifications.

  • Application of lubricants or other materials to machines or their parts as well as other equipment per stated procedures.

  • Eagerness and ability to comprehend general maintenance in all aspects of the maintenance program.

  • Perform daily Preventative Maintenance on equipment.

  • Must exhibit outstanding ability to learn and comprehend the fundamentals of the functioning of machines.

  • Carries out scheduled maintenance examinations and fixes, cleans, and align diverse systems to guarantee appropriate system operations.

  • Performs maintenance, installations, and repairs, of HVAC systems, electrical systems, plumbing systems, and carpentry work as needed.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Experience

  • 4-5 years of Machine Maintenance experience with electrical knowledge

  • Ability to communicate with all levels of personnel, including staff, vendors, and management.

  • Intermediate computer skills required (Microsoft Office Suite).

Requirements

  • Ability to pass a mechanical aptitude test.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Associate's degree in mechatronics or industrial electronics or equivalent experience.

Physical Demands

  • Standing for extended periods.

  • Repetitive motion.

  • Frequent bending, stooping, pushing, and pulling.

  • Occasional lifting up to 50lbs – team lifts over 50lbs.

  • Able to work in various temperature conditions.

Note *** The physical and weight-lifting demands described here must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Internal Qualifications

  • No final warnings

  • No more than 6 attendance points

  • Efficiency and Quality goals met for the previous 3 months.

  • Must be in current role for 6+ months.

  • Must meet all job description requirements.

detail.title: Project Leader – New Product Development (NPD)
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

The Project Leader – New Product Development (NPD) is responsible for leading the overall execution of moderate to high complexity product development initiatives, with minimal oversight.  This role owns the technical scope, drives key design decisions and trade-off analyses, and coordinates cross-functional execution while maintaining full accountability for project delivery and cost.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drives overall project from concept to mass production, coordinating with cross-functional team and motivating them to accomplish project objectives.
  • Responsible for meeting cost, schedule, and performance targets during project execution.
  • Establishes and reinforces strong culture within project team.
  • Holds team members accountable for individual responsibilities during project.
  • Recognizes when escalation is needed, then effectively escalates to leadership.
  • Creates and tracks schedules and facilitates and documents project meetings.
  • Consistently visualizes entire scope of a project with very little guidance.
  • Effectively tracks project risks,
  • Leads tradeoff discussions with product management and other cross-functional team members.
  • Demonstrates effective negotiation skills to reach a compromise when needed.
  • Presents project updates, risks, and business cases to leadership.
  • Ensures component delivery via close coordination with US/Asia sourcing and supply chain teams.
  • Coordinates build readiness planning throughout the development process with cross-functional departments.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in related field
  • Strong understanding of electromechanical systems, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Results driven and deadline orientated. Ability to manage projects with extreme ownership to aggressive schedules and results. Ability to handle fast paced, and agile culture.  Ability to adapt to constant change and competing priorities. 
  • Excellent problem identification and resolution skills
  • Experience working on cross-functional teams.
  • Thrive in a collaborative work environment. Ability to develop and nurture productive business relationships, and influence and educate internal team members and external suppliers.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and project leadership skills.
  • 3-10% travel is required.

detail.title: Safety Manager
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for a Safety Manager within multiple Distribution Centers. The Distribution Center Safety Manager leads all safety, health, and regulatory compliance activities within the distribution center. The role partners with operations leadership to build a proactive safety culture, reduce risk, ensure compliance, and support efficient warehouse operations through training, auditing, incident prevention, and continuous improvement initiatives.

We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and sustain safety programs, policies, and procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, DOT, and applicable regulations.
  • Lead audits, inspections, risk assessments, and hazard analyses.
  • Manage incident investigations and corrective actions.
  • Deliver safety training and onboarding programs.
  • Monitor warehouse traffic, powered industrial trucks, dock operations, racking systems, and material handling processes.
  • Lead emergency preparedness and response planning.
  • Communicate safety performance metrics and recommendations to leadership.

Competencies & Leadership Behaviors

  • Safety Leadership and Accountability
  • Strategic Thinking and Risk Assessment
  • Influencing and Coaching Others
  • Decision Making and Problem Solving
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Change Management
  • Effective Communication and Presentation Skills

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to walk distribution center floors for extended periods.
  • Ability to climb stairs, access mezzanines, and inspect warehouse equipment.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Ability to respond to emergencies across all facility areas.

Working Conditions

  • Distribution center and warehouse environment.
  • Frequent exposure to forklifts, conveyors, shipping docks, and material handling equipment.
  • Combination of office and floor presence.
  • May support multiple shifts, weekends, or emergency response situations when necessary.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • OSHA Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR)
  • Lost Time Incident Rate (LTIR)
  • Near-Miss Reporting Participation
  • Safety Training Completion Rate
  • Audit and Inspection Scores
  • Corrective Action Closure Rate
  • Workers Compensation Cost Reduction
  • Forklift and Material Handling Incident Reduction

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Health, Engineering, Environmental Science, or related field.
  • 5+ years of safety leadership experience in distribution, warehousing, logistics, manufacturing, or industrial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of OSHA regulations and safety management systems.
  • Experience conducting investigations and managing corrective actions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CSP, ASP, CHST, OSHA 30-Hour, or equivalent certification.
  • Experience in high-volume distribution center environments.
  • Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement experience.
  • Knowledge of WMS and warehouse automation.

detail.title: Senior Technical Designer - PPE
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

SENIOR TECHNICAL DESIGNER – PPE

POSITION OVERVIEW

 

At Milwaukee Tool, we are committed to delivering innovative Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) that helps keep users safe, productive, and confident on the jobsite. As we continue to expand our PPE portfolio, we are seeking a Senior Technical Designer with 5-10 years of apparel experience to join our Industrial Design team.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly collaborative, naturally curious, creative, and adaptable. The successful candidate will play a critical role in translating product concepts into production-ready solutions, helping shape new product categories while ensuring exceptional fit, function, and user experience. We are looking for a highly engaged team member who is excited to push boundaries and deliver best-in-class PPE products.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Senior Technical Designer is responsible for developing and executing product construction specifications, fit standards, and technical solutions that bring design intent to life. This role ensures PPE products meet Milwaukee Tool's high standards for performance, comfort, durability, and quality across multiple product categories. 

 

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive material usage efficiency through marker analysis.

  • Develop detailed construction specifications, technical packages, and product documentation for cut-and-sewn PPE products.

  • Drive product fit, ergonomics, comfort, and usability through prototyping, testing, and refinement.

  • Create and maintain measurement specifications, grading standards, and fit requirements.

  • Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners to ensure design intent is accurately translated into production.

  • Apply advanced pattern theory principles to ensure accurate garment fit, grading, and conformance to product safety standards.​

detail.title: Design Engineer II
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Design Engineer II – Power Tools NPD 

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence. 

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. 

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE. 

As a Design Engineer II for Milwaukee you will be located at our Brookfield, WI office. Our corporate office is only 15 minutes from downtown Milwaukee and located near American Family Field, Milwaukee Zoo, Mitchell Park Domes, as well as many more attractions and restaurants.  

You will work in a fast-paced environment to innovate new products as a member of a cross-functional team. One of the most rewarding aspects of the job is seeing a product you designed on the shelves of a Home Depot.  

If you are interested in travel, domestic and international travel opportunities are available and sometimes required. In the US, Milwaukee Tool has three locations in Mississippi (two manufacturing and one distribution). Overseas, you will have the opportunity to work with Chinese engineering counterparts as well as meet with suppliers in both Taiwan and China.  
 
Milwaukee Electric Tool offers benefits on your first day of work (health, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k) and an excellent working environment that includes an on-site cafeteria as well as a state of the art fitness facility! 

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities: 

  • Take a concept idea and make it come to life.  
  • Design and test products from concept to production.  
  • Develop design solutions to meet consumer requirements.  
  • Participate in field research.  
  • Facilitate project flow involving regular contact with manufacturing and other cross-functional team members.  
  • Interact with suppliers to develop part/product specifications that meet performance requirements while falling within process capabilities.  
  • Evaluate product design relative to material selection, cost and reliability.  
  • Perform a wide variety of calculations and software aided analyses in the following areas:  
  • Mechanical stress analysis, material and heat treatment selection, tolerance and fit analyses, lubrication, spur and helical gear design, statics and dynamics, noise and vibration and a variety of machine element design.  
  • Independently develop, write and analyze test requests with the Milwaukee Tool Test Laboratory.  
  • Work as a technical resource to troubleshoot problems with manufacturing teams and suppliers.  

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you: 

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering; or similar field.  
  • 2+ years of experience in related design field.  
  • Experience in participating or leading cross functional team meetings   
  • GD & T and CAD proficiency  
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands-on attitude.  
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel and Power Point.  
  • Willingness to learn skill sets outside primary discipline.  
  • Ability to travel 10% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International).  
  • High interest in tools of the trade.  

We provide these great perks and benefits: 

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans. 
  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan. 
  • Education assistance. 
  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service. 

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

FIELD SALES AND MARKETING REPRESENTATIVE – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provides TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Hart ®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this position, you will drive sales of our premier product lines within one of our largest retail partners. This position will allow you to enhance your selling, account management, and communication skills while launching your career in a fast-paced and extremely rewarding company.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm
  • Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through
  • Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through
  • Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact
  • Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics
  • Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market
  • Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships
  • Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities
  • Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

  • Must be at least 21 years of age or older
  • Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions
  • Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening
  • Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state
  • Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation
  • Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver
  • Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required
  • Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies)
  • Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product
  • Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed
  • Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays
  • Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year
  • Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks
  • Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills
  • The applicant must be MS Office proficient
  • Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs
  • Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered
  • Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)
  • The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000
  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)
  • Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year
  • Company iPhone and iPad
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available
  • Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more
  • 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)
  • Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holidays (Based on hire date)
  • Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date
  • Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

rows.title: IT Advisor- Salesforce CG Cloud Administrator

detail.title: IT Advisor- Salesforce CG Cloud Administrator
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

WE CREATE EMPOWERED LEADERS! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success.

Your Role on Our Team

As the IT Advisor-Salesforce CG Cloud Administrator, you will serve as the primary functional administrator and platform expert supporting our Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud ecosystem. You will partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations, Channel, Marketing, Revenue Growth Management, Field Sales, and IT teams to ensure the platform delivers exceptional user experience, enables commercial excellence, and supports scalable business growth.

You will own the day-to-day administration, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of Consumer Goods Cloud while partnering with business stakeholders, solution architects, developers, and implementation partners to deliver new capabilities and maximize platform value.

This role is central to ensuring Salesforce remains a trusted, high-performing commercial platform by driving user adoption, process optimization, data quality, and operational excellence.

**Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary administrator for Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, supporting business users across Channel, Sales, Field Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, and Commercial Operations.
  • Configure and maintain Salesforce using declarative tools including Flows, Dynamic Forms, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, Reports, Dashboards, List Views, Record Types, Permission Sets, and Lightning Apps.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, identify process improvements, and translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Support Consumer Goods Cloud capabilities including retail execution, account planning, visit planning, store audits, surveys, action plans, product assortment, and customer engagement.
  • Administer Salesforce objects, page layouts, security model, user provisioning, role hierarchy, profiles, sharing rules, and field-level security.
  • Build reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights into sales performance, retail execution, customer activity, and operational KPIs.
  • Monitor system health, data quality, platform adoption, and user experience while proactively identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Support Salesforce releases by evaluating new platform capabilities, coordinating testing, documenting enhancements, and enabling business adoption.
  • Manage user support, troubleshoot production issues, coordinate defect resolution, and ensure timely delivery of enhancements.
  • Partner with architects, developers, and implementation partners to support larger projects, integrations, and platform enhancements.
  • Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, user acceptance testing, training, and change management activities.
  • Develop and maintain platform documentation including configuration standards, process documentation, user guides, and knowledge articles.
  • Promote Salesforce best practices, governance standards, and data integrity across the commercial organization.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

The TOOLS you'll bring with you:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Computer Science, or related field preferred or equivalent experience.
  • 2-4+ years of experience administering Salesforce in an enterprise environment.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification required or ability to obtain within six months.
  • Experience supporting business users and delivering Salesforce enhancements through Agile delivery methodologies.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

  • Experience administering Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or comparable CRM platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Consumer Goods business processes including retail execution, account planning, field sales, customer visits, product assortment, promotions, and merchandising.
  • Experience configuring Salesforce using Flow Builder, Reports, Dashboards, Validation Rules, Permission Sets, Dynamic Forms, and Lightning Experience.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce data model, security architecture, sharing model, and declarative automation best practices.
  • Experience supporting integrations with ERP platforms such as Oracle Cloud, customer master data, product master data, and enterprise integration platforms.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Trade Promotion Management, or Revenue Growth Management solutions.
  • Experience supporting mobile-first Salesforce applications used by field sales organizations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and recommend scalable solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into effective Salesforce configurations.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative team player who builds trusted relationships across business and IT organizations.
  • Passion for continuous learning, platform innovation, and delivering exceptional user experiences.
  • Hands-on administrator who thrives on improving business processes through thoughtful platform configuration and automation while maintaining high standards for data quality, usability, and operational excellence.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for an Operations Manager that is responsible for supervising the distribution associates, responsible for the receipt, storage, order filling, or loading of inventory as it relates to the daily distribution activities within assigned area(s) of a distribution facility, and has functional responsibility for one large or multiple areas such as receiving, bin or bulk picking & outbound functions. We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation, and holidays.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supervise the receipt, storage, order filling, or loading of inventory.
  • Provide leadership and motivation to associates. Communicate effectively with associates and create an open communication style that fosters a collaborative work environment.
  • Assist management in problem-solving and coordinating projects.
  • Recruit, train, and develop department associates. Short-term coverage planning for staffing requirements and resource allocations.
  • Conduct associate performance reviews, ongoing performance discussions, and salary review recommendations. Monitor and record productivity and accuracy for the assigned area.
  • Administer safety programs and ensure OSHA compliance. Communicate and administer policies and procedures in the assigned area.
  • Ensures that the physical condition of the warehouse is conducive to a healthy and safe working environment.
  • The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 5 years' experience in a production, logistics, or business-to-business distribution facility with two years of supervisory experience
  • Area of study in business, engineering, or logistics, distribution management preferred. Logistics to include shipping, receiving inventory, and quantitative methods
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, strong knowledge of warehouse operations and procedures, proven decision-making capabilities, and ability to manage and motivate employees.
  • Knowledge of Warehouse operations, Warehouse Management Systems, Inventory Control processes, and/or logistics preferred.
  • Self-motivated, self-starter, team player, ability to work unsupervised to complete tasks, follow-up skills, work through change, and deliver tough messages as it relates to associate performance, flexible as schedule may change as business needs change
  • Financial literacy - the ability to forecast business and adjust to business conditions.

Environment: 


This position requires managing dynamic circumstances and having the ability to make sound, independent decisions based on multiple considerations. Must interface and be able to establish cohesive relationships across departments. Must be able to effectively engage with a wide range of personnel under all situations and be both directive and responsive. Communication, interpersonal, planning, organization, and decision-making skills are important.

Physical:

  • May require some heavy lifting (up to 50 lbs.) as well as other moderate physical effort, including bending and stooping.

  • Efficiency and Quality goals met for the previous 3 months.
  • Must be in current role for 6+ months.
  • Must meet all job description requirements.

rows.title: Project Leader – Power Tool Accessories NPD

detail.title: Project Leader – Power Tool Accessories NPD
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success -- so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our engineering teams. Our Accessories New Product Development Team is responsible for giving life to the cutting, drilling, driving, masonry, and abrasive accessories that are changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in engineering resources to design and develop leadership in engineering capabilities; something unique within the industry, and we're pushing the limits. 

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

The Project Leader is responsible for managing multiple moderate to highly complex engineering projects with minimal direction. Individuals in this position will provide project management and necessary technical direction to assure successful and timely implementation of projects to support New Product Development, Continuous Improvement, Value Engineering, and Product support across your specific product category specifically within our NPD Accessories business unit.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities: 

At Milwaukee Tool, our culture drives everything we do, and our people are the foundation on which our Culture is built.  As One Team we relentlessly build and grow our Culture that is focused on: creating disruptive innovation, taking unparalleled pride in our work and brand, and doing what's best for our users. We require cultural passion and commitment, as appropriate to work position, of everyone who is employed at Milwaukee Tool.

As a Project Leader at Milwaukee Tool Accessories, you will work in a dynamic, cross-functional environment, collaborating daily with your peers across Project Management, Engineering, Quality, Product Management, Operations, and Supply Chain.  In order to move fast and stay connected with your on-site peers, this position is on-premises.  It is not a remote position.

  • Provides leadership over high complexity/high item (SKU) count/full category projects, including Next Generation/new to Milwaukee Tool/New to World.  Provides direction, guidance, and engineering expertise to team members. Review work of designers, engineers, and other project team members.
  • Responsible for the completion of assigned engineering projects within budgetary and scheduling guidelines.
  • Communicates, both verbal and written, to assure all groups are working toward the goal of timely project completion. Communicate technical details, ideas, and concepts to engineers and non-engineers in multiple locations.
  • Drive design of project to meet market driven design guides and fulfill cost, timing, reliability, and high-volume manufacturing requirements.
  • Identify project risks and implement risk reduction plans.
  • Analyze, evaluate, and select from design execution alternatives to best meet specification objectives and implement designs into mass production.
  • Accountable for technical elements of project execution including integration of complicated components and assemblies, material selection, packaging, and safety, regulatory and standards compliance.
  • Conduct design and safety reviews as needed to gain necessary approvals for product development phase progressions.
  • Comply with all Milwaukee Tool procedures covering new product development and design output in addition to procedures of non-engineering departments related to project flow.
  • Consistently visualizes entire scope of a project with very little guidance.
  • Schedules, develops agendas, facilitates, and documents project meetings.
  • Tracks project schedule to ensure adherence to timelines.
  • Regularly makes presentations of project status.
  • May occasionally recommend changes to existing standards and procedures.
  • Maintains an awareness of competitive offerings and the general business climate in the power tool industry.
  • Does not have formal supervisory responsibilities, although will provide input for performance appraisals for Engineering and cross functional project team members. Also oversees day-to-day activities of project team members.
  • Interacts extensively with manufacturing plants and outside suppliers to achieve project goals.
  • Makes component material or process recommendations.
  • Independently leads a cross functional team in the development of custom high output capabilities for advanced performance power tool accessories, including specialized manufacturing equipment.
  • Designs new experiments and test systems.
  • Exhibits vision and foresight to test the extremes of a design and guide the team members through well thought out, logical test regimes.
  • Directs high complexity design optimization DOEs and root cause analysis to generate design alternatives.
  • Performs various other duties to support the larger business needs as assigned and directed by management.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering. Graduate studies preferred in the business areas such as Project Management, Finance, Marketing, or Organizational studies. Formal project management training preferred.
  • Minimum 7 years engineering experience in related field.
  • Experience successfully managing low-moderate complexity projects and/or subsystems of larger projects.
  • Must possess a high level of Mechanical/Electrical engineering aptitude.
  • Must have a working design knowledge of a wide variety of the technologies associated with Milwaukee products.
  • Ability to draft comprehensive test plans and specifications.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office software including Microsoft Project.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% travel includes both Domestic and International.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.
  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan.
  • Education assistance.
  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.
