Your Role on Our Team

The Senior Electronics Calibration Technician will perform advanced calibration, adjustment, and troubleshooting of electronic test equipment, including digital multimeters (DMMs), analog and digital oscilloscopes, power supplies and electronic loads, current shunts, probes, signal generators, data acquisition systems, and specialized lab instrumentation. This role will analyze measurement performance and determine calibration requirements for new and existing equipment, conduct root cause analysis on out-of-tolerance conditions, and implement corrective actions. The technician will interpret calibration data to ensure traceability to national and international standards, act as a key technical resource for engineering teams on measurement-related issues, and support workload planning and prioritization of calibration activities based on business needs.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

  • Maintain and improve calibration systems and databases (e.g., scheduling, certification records, traceability)
  • Ensure all equipment is calibrated within required intervals to support engineering timelines and testing throughput
  • Develop and standardize calibration procedures and best practices across labs
  • Support internal and external audits, including documentation readiness and compliance verification
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to support:
    • Test system validation
    • Measurement capability studies
    • Equipment selection and specification
  • Serve as the primary interface with external calibration providers when required
  • Support urgent measurement and test equipment issues impacting product development timelines
  • Identify opportunities to insource calibration and reduce outsourced costs through internal capability expansion (aligned with current business initiatives)
  • Evaluate new calibration equipment and technologies
  • Contribute to long-term calibration strategy, including lab capability growth and standardization

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, Military experience in related field or equivalent work experience. 
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience calibrating electronic test equipment
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Electrical measurement principles (voltage, current, resistance, frequency, power)
    • Calibration methods and traceability concepts
  • Experience working in a regulated or structured quality environment
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, organization, collaboration, project coordination, and continuous improvement skills.

Other TOOLS that are nice to have:

  • Experience with ISO/IEC 17025 or similar quality standards
  • Experience with IndySoft and MET/CONNECT
  • Familiarity with uncertainty analysis and measurement system analysis (MSA)
  • Experience with calibration software or asset management systems
  • Knowledge of statistical tools (e.g., Minitab)
  • Exposure to fixture design or automated test systems

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams.

rows.title: Design Engineer I – New Product Development Engineering

detail.title: Design Engineer I – New Product Development Engineering
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Design Engineer I – New Product Development Engineering

The Design Engineer I supports the design and development of outdoor power equipment (OPE) systems and components. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and engineering leadership, this role contributes to product development from concept through production by creating detailed designs, supporting prototype builds, conducting testing, and assisting with product validation. The Design Engineer I develops technical skills while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, manufacturable products.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Technical Design Ownership

  • Supports the design and development for assigned components, sub‑assemblies, or systems from concept, layout, and detailed CAD through validation and production release.
  • Develops and maintains 3D CAD models, 2D drawings, GD&T, tolerance stacks, and specifications to ensure functional performance, regulatory compliance, durability, safety, and manufacturability.
  • Ability to analyze problems and provide design trade‑off analyses (performance, cost, weight, manufacturability, reliability) and documents rationale for design decisions.
  • Applies structured problem‑solving methods to resolve design issues, field failures, and manufacturing concerns.
  • Learns and applies sound engineering principles while developing technical judgment.

Design for Manufacturing, Cost, and Quality

  • Designs components with consideration for manufacturability, assembly, quality, and cost.
  • Works with manufacturing engineering, sourcing, quality, and suppliers to understand the processes and design constraints.
  • Supports value engineering and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensures designs comply with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and applicable UL / ANSI / CSA / ISO expectations.

Verification & Validation

  • Supports DFMEA inputs, design risks, and mitigation strategies for designs.
  • Supports the development and execution of design verification plans including tolerance validation, stress analysis, durability testing, environmental testing, and abuse testing.
  • Uses data‑driven test results to refine designs and confirm requirements are met with appropriate margin.
  • Supporting engineering change documentation and product release activities.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborates with Product Management to understand customer requirements and product objectives.
  • Supports Manufacturing Engineering during pilot builds, PPAP, and ramp‑up by resolving build issues and incorporating feedback into design revisions.
  • Communicates effectively with global cross-functional teams

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • 0-3 years of design experience in consumer, industrial, or electromechanical products (internship and co-op experience considered).
  • Experience with 3D CAD (Creo / SolidWorks / NX or equivalent).
  • Basic understanding of engineering drawings and GD&T.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, results‑driven product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Internship or co-op experience in product development or manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, machining, or other manufacturing processes.
  • Hands-on mechanical aptitude.
  • Experience with prototype assembly and product testing.

Travel

  • Up to 25% travel (International and Domestic)

detail.title: Field Sales & Marketing Representative - Kyle, TX
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

FIELD SALES AND MARKETING REPRESENTATIVE – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provides TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Hart ®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this position, you will drive sales of our premier product lines within one of our largest retail partners. This position will allow you to enhance your selling, account management, and communication skills while launching your career in a fast-paced and extremely rewarding company.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm
  • Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through
  • Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through
  • Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact
  • Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics
  • Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market
  • Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships
  • Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities
  • Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

  • Must be at least 21 years of age or older
  • Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions
  • Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening
  • Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state
  • Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation
  • Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver
  • Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required
  • Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies)
  • Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product
  • Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed
  • Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays
  • Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year
  • Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks
  • Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills
  • The applicant must be MS Office proficient
  • Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs
  • Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered
  • Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)
  • The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000
  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)
  • Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year
  • Company iPhone and iPad
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available
  • Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more
  • 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)
  • Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holidays (Based on hire date)
  • Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date
  • Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Techtronic Industries Power Equipment, a subsidiary of TTI, has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for a Project Engineer 1 to be responsible for managing multiple projects from early concept to mass production and will be part of an international team based in Anderson, SC. This position will provide project management and necessary technical direction to assure successful and timely implementation of new products.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Direct daily communications, both verbal and written, to ensure all groups are working toward the goal of timely project completion. Must be able to communicate technical details and concepts to engineers and non-technical team members in Anderson and internationally.

  • Conduct design and safety reviews as needed to gain necessary approvals for product development phase progression.
  • Drive quality compliance as related to project work. Utilize appropriate design development tools and techniques such as Value and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis, Design of experiments, design for manufacture, assembly and inspection, CAD analysis and 3D Design Tools.
  • Initiate and follow patent searches to assure infringement clearance of existing patents. Participate in developing patents to protect innovation.
  • International travel required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

BS Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience.

Preferred Experience:

  • Mechanical engineering
  • Plastic tooling
  • Structural design
  • Consumer product design
  • Product development of electronic consumer products

detail.title: Product Safety Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.  

 

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility. To learn more about the Milwaukee story and our company click HERE.  

 

As a Product Safety Engineer for Milwaukee Tool, you will be located at our Corporate Headquarters in Brookfield, WI. You will work in a fast-paced environment to define safety requirements as a member of a cross-functional design team. You will utilize engineering skills to contribute to the development and qualification of new products within Milwaukee Tool.

  

Your primary duty is to assist in the coordination and execution of Hazard Analysis Reviews of Milwaukee products.  

  

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:   

 

  • Define safety requirements as a member of a cross-functional design team. Contribute to the development and qualification of new products for the New Product Development business unit.

  • Conduct Hazard Analysis Reviews with cross-functional engineering teams to perform risk assessments of concepts, designs, and products.

  • Advise Project Leaders, Product Managers, Design Engineers, and Reliability Engineers regarding safety requirements including tests and design constraints to minimize risk of injury and/or property damage.

  • Effectively communicate with a diverse range of technical and non-technical team members.

  • Support the execution of Hazard Analysis Reviews and other safety activities on assigned categories based on industry safety standards, product rules, and product regulations.

  • Review embedded system designs.

  • Conduct product design and construction reviews. Review test results and determine acceptability.

  • Review operator's manuals, on-product markings, and other technical communications 

  

Education & Work Experience Requirement: (bachelor, master or other degree and field of study; any certifications required for the role; number of years prior relevant work experience needed to perform the job offered):  

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical or Mechanical preferred) or technical equivalent.

 

Minimum Requirements of Role: 

  • Handling product safety activities, regulatory listings design of power tools, Li-ion battery packs/systems, battery chargers, outdoor power equipment or consumer products 

  • Risk-Based Hazard Analysis

  • Perform and review failure mode and effects analysis 

  • Fault Tree Analysis

  • Electrical Circuit Analysis 

  

We provide these great perks and benefits:   

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.  

  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan.  

  • Education assistance.  

  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food and coffee service.  

  • And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

detail.title: Senior Reliability Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

Milwaukee Tool is looking for a Senior Reliability Engineer to be part of the Battery System Reliability team.  This role will be a vital part of the development of new energized device products that will provide power to the next generation of advanced power tools.  As a senior reliability engineer, you will work with a cross-functional team spanning design engineering, product marketing engineering, advanced manufacturing engineering, supplier quality, and factory quality personnel to bring products to market in a fast paced environment.  This work environment requires the ability to quickly pivot, manage change, and analyze test data to make sound judgements; all in the effort to continue to deliver the outstanding products that our customers demand from Milwaukee Tool.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Product Development and Life Cycle Management

  • Collaborate and lead teams to evaluate new product designs and engineering changes with respect to product reliability, user requirements and warranty information

  • Coordinate with Engineering and Marketing to define product specifications required for all aspects of test validation for reliability and quality requirements.

  • Optimize product testing to shorten test durations, make concrete design decisions, and shorten the product development process.

  • Lead Risk Assessments (Design and Manufacturing) during the product development cycle

  • Collaborate with our Global suppliers to optimize the quality of the components that Milwaukee integrates into its product portfolio.

  • Track multiple projects simultaneously to ensure adherence to schedule and the Milwaukee Tool process.

Testing/Analysis

  • Develop test plans and procedures based on new or established products, to ensure product meets customer requirements 

  • Lead test laboratories implementing test plans/procedures ensuring full test completion and best practices are utilized

  • Apply statistical analysis and reliability modeling, to analyze product data to draw conclusions, and communicate findings through reports and presentations that are concise, logical, and definitive..

  • Ensure timely failure reporting and lead root cause analysis and effective corrective/preventative actions (FRACA) 

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or educational equivalent field 

  • 5+ years of experience in related reliability and quality field 

  • Experience with new product commercialization processes emphasizing design, manufacturing, quality, test or reliability activities

  • Experience including training in quality engineering fundamentals and proven experience leading a primary function within a project team

  • Previous relevant experience with Design of Experiments, life data analysis, and other related statistical tools and software (i.e. Minitab, Reliasoft)

  • Written and verbal communication skills and creative problem-solving capabilities

  • Ability to travel 10% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International)

  • Preferred: ASQ Reliability Engineering Certification (ASQ-CRE) or the ability and desire to achieve certification

  • Preferred: Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) or Six Sigma experience

  • Preferred: 2+ years of experience working with power electronics design and reliability

  • Preferred: Working knowledge of international safety standards and testing methods like IEC, UL, UN, etc relevant to energy storage products.  

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive considration for employment  without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.
 

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

PRODUCTION ASSEMBLER I 

Purpose of the Position: 

The Assembler I is responsible for maintaining accuracy, quality, and efficiency while performing light assembly duties and production tasks.  

The position reports to the Production Supervisor at Milwaukee Tool.

Work Schedule:

1st Shift: Monday-Thursday 5:00am-3:00pm

2nd Shift: Monday- Thursday 3:00pm-1:00am

Weekend Shift: Friday-Sunday7:00am-7:00pm

Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Light assembly and packaging of product  

  • General warehouse duties: stacking, moving, arranging product  

  • Maintains expected productivity output levels and completes assignments as scheduled 

  • Builds assemblies to quality standards and print or work order specifications 

  • Follows verbal and written procedures including when modified by a Lead or Supervisor 

  • Maintains a clean and organized work environment including after task clean up, returning tools to designated locations and swept floor  

  • Flexibility in daily tasks including rotating positions and changing work stations  

  • Possibly operating minor machinery or equipment to aid in production processes  

  • Adheres to IB implemented safety standards including (PPE), work practice controls, and OSHA guidelines 

  • Is willing to learn new tasks, procedures and assemblies as needed 

  • Listens, understands and follows instructions while learning new assignments 

  • Recognizes unusual circumstances and asks questions to Team Leads when necessary 

  • Requests are completed with a good attitude and by needed deadlines 

  • May be assigned special projects and other duties 

Skills & Qualifications: 

  • Possess manual dexterity and good coordination 

  • Must have good oral and written communication skills 

  • Possess basic reading, writing, and math skills (including adding, subtracting, calculating percentages, converting minutes to hours, and performing basic Algebra) 

  • Possess necessary basic computer skills for accessing and printing documents/labels 

  • Possess ability to resolve minor problems, recognize normal and unusual situations 

  • Ability to work with manual and/or power equipment and tools 

  • Possess proven mechanical ability or aptitude 

  • Is able to follow assembly simple production diagrams 

  • Demonstrates strong multitasking skills in a fast paced environment 

  • Accuracy and attention to detail required 

  • Coachable and applies instruction immediately 

  • Maintains a positive attitude and remains flexible to changing work environment 

Education and/or Experience: 

  • HS diploma or equivalent (GED) required 

  • Previous production, assembly or packaging related experience preferred 

  • Has worked independently and as part of a team 

  • Basic English skills to understand quality, safety, work instructions, personnel information, etc. 

Physical Demands & Work Environment: 

  • The employee may be required to frequently lift, carry, push or pull up to 50 pounds 

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus 

  • Prolonged standing of eight or more hours a day  

  • Frequent walking  

  • Occasional bending, crouching, twisting, reaching 

  • Employees may be required to wear the proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in certain work cells

detail.title: Operations Project Leader
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Operations Project Leader – Byhalia Kitting & MFG

 

INNOVATE without boundaries! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success.

 

We are an inclusive workplace that encourages diversity of thought, experience, and background to solve complex problems as one team. Every employee is encouraged to continuously improve and grow, and it is a top priority for managers to develop their teams, making a wide range of internal development opportunities available to all employees.

 

We are One Team, overcoming obstacles together and celebrating together. Come be part of a winning team that feels like family.

 

Your Role on Our Team:

The Project Leader is responsible for managing multiple moderate to highly complex engineering projects for strategic initiatives with minimal direction. You will be utilizing your technical skills and project management ability to support new product development (NPD) launches, manufacturing support initiatives, risk mitigation efforts and strategic transfer execution.  This role will manage the relationships between internal and external teams involved in the NPD process.   Individuals in this position will provide project management and necessary technical direction to assure successful and timely implementation of projects. This role will be focused on long term initiatives and vetting future strategies for all facets of manufacturing in Byhalia, MS.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities: 

·           Provides leadership over moderate to highly complex operations projects for NPD, process improvement, future strategies, and manufacturing support with minimal direction

·           Utilize data-driven decision making to influence key stakeholders

·           Provides direction, guidance, and engineering expertise to team members

·           Work cross-functionally and globally with Quality & Reliability, Engineering, Sourcing, Finance, Supply and Demand, Marketing, and other departments

·           Effectively track and communicate milestones (QB, MP, PR, ship dates, etc.) to key stakeholders.

·           Ensure successful transitions from project team support to operations management.

·           Review work of manufacturing engineers, process engineers and other project team members

·           Perform data analysis to produce information and provide detailed reports to decision makers

·           Responsible for the completion of assigned NPD projects within budgetary and scheduling guidelines

·           Communicates, both verbal and written, to assure all groups are working toward the goal of timely project completion

·           Communicate technical details, ideas, and concepts to engineers and non-engineers in multiple locations

  • Lead operational readiness & implementation.  Accountable for technical elements of project execution including integration of equipment, tooling, capability reviews, manufacturing process and safety, regulatory and standards compliance.

·           Consistently visualizes entire scope of a project with very little guidance

·           Tracks project schedule to ensure adherence to timelines

·           Interpret data and make corresponding recommendations including but not limited to:

o   Impact to financials (GM and EBIT, total CapEx)

o   Intermediate supply chain design analysis

o   End to end logistics modeling

o   Risk trade off for short and long term strategy

o   Line layout considerations for NPD if in house

·           Recommend changes to existing standards and procedures

 

 

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or engineering related field.
  • Minimum 2 years’ engineering experience in related field
  • Experience successfully managing low-moderate complexity projects and/or subsystems of larger projects
  • Must be able to personally conduct detailed analyses or recognize the need and seek the appropriate expertise to achieve the desired results
  • CAD Skills Level:  Basic 2D
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office software
  • Travel required to execute critical projects/initiatives (frequency dependent upon project)
  • undefinedOther TOOLS we prefer you to have:Knowledge of the technologies associated with manufacturing and kitting processesGraduate studies in business areas such as Project Management, Finance, Marketing, or Organizational studiesFormal project management training preferred

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

You will work in a fast-paced environment to innovate new products as a member of a cross-functional team. One of the most rewarding aspects of the job is seeing a product you designed on the shelves of a Home Depot. 

If you are interested in travel, domestic and international travel opportunities are available and sometimes required. In the US, Milwaukee Tool has three locations in Mississippi (two manufacturing and one distribution). Overseas, you will have the opportunity to work with Chinese engineering counterparts as well as meet with suppliers in both Taiwan and China.

Job Description:

Field Sales and Marketing Representative – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.
  • Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.
  • Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.
  • Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

  • Must be at least 21 years of age or older.
  • Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.
  • Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.
  • Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.
  • Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

  • Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.
  • Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.
  • Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.
  • The applicant must be MS Office proficient.
  • Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.
  • Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

detail.title: Sr Electrical Engineer - Embedded Hardware
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence. 

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.  

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Senior Electrical Engineer – Embedded Hardware will be responsible for designing, adapting, and troubleshooting embedded communications circuits for performance, cost, and manufacturability. Hardware circuits could include MCUs, antenna tuning, filters, low-noise amplifiers, transmit amplifiers, transceivers, and low noise power supplies to operate these circuits. The Senior Engineer will also be responsible for driving awareness of MCU selection/evaluation, product regulations and working with project teams to drive new intelligent feature design release.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

  • Mentor junior engineers in engineering best practices including task management, Gantt charts, root cause analysis, circuit / PCB design, and PCBA manufacturing.
  • Design, prototype, test, and troubleshoot hardware for communications applications at a platform level to meet Milwaukee Tool’s needs. 
  • Design and qualify new designs to applicable regulatory standards such as FCC, IC, CE, UL, Bluetooth, NFC, etc.
  • Lead technology investigations, develop system requirements, define future architectures and reusability strategies.
  • Work with marketing, project leadership, and product owners to add new communications features for next generation power tools, both wired and wireless
  • Use laboratory equipment such as network analyzers, power analyzers, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers, oscilloscopes, and data acquisition systems.
  • Lead the development of test plans/procedures and test cases for new product embedded systems and subsystems development.
  • Make minor firmware modifications to generate and adjust prototypes
  • Effectively communicate and motivate up, down and across the organization to a diverse range of technical and non-technical team members. Driving effective tradeoff discussions.
  • Drive urgency in project schedules and accountability for establishing and achieving key project metrics that meet the organization’s needs.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
  • 5+ years of embedded systems experience, including MCU selection/evaluation
  • Understanding of digital circuits and the interaction between firmware and electronics in a communications system.
  • Ability to realize component level design and test for signal integrity
  • Familiarity with using schematic capture, PCB layout software, and knowledge of industry best practices.
  • Proficiency in creating sub-system and component level design requirements.
  • Proficiency with standard lab equipment and specialized communication test equipment.
  • Self-motivated, organized, efficient, and process oriented with a strong work ethic.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, exercises independent judgement and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment. 
  • Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international).  

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

  • Master's degree in electrical engineering or related field.
  • Working knowledge of a second modern programming language such as Python or C++.
  • Familiarity of wireless regulatory certification standards such as FCC, IC, CE, etc. 
  • Knowledge of Bluetooth Low Energy protocols and features and understanding power management and ultra-low power embedded hardware and firmware implementations

We provide these great perks and benefits:

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.
  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan.
  • Education assistance.
  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.
  • And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

Our Talent Management Team is committed to providing support, tools, programs, and innovative technologies that allow our leaders to build inclusive, high-performing teams. We achieve this by partnering with leadership to create proactive talent solutions to optimize the organization's short and long-term goals. Our focus on the employee experience enables us to attract, develop, engage, and retain people to their full potential. 

 

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to enhance the people behind the biggest breakthroughs in industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. 

 

Your Role on Our Team 

As the Human Resources Manager you will be excited by the variety of work and will thrive in this tremendously fast paced environment. You will enjoy working on many things at once and at a very quick pace. In this position, you will build collaborative relationships across the organization and will be a key influencer and trusted advisor in your role.

 

Role Overview 

The Human Resources Manager serves as a strategic partner to business leaders, providing end-to-end talent support that drives organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and business performance. This role operates as a trusted advisor with an earned seat at the leadership table, influencing decisions through data, insight, and strong business acumen. In this role, you will be responsible for aligning Talent strategies to business goals, coaching senior leaders, and ensuring compliance while fostering a high-performing, inclusive culture.

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities: 

 

Strategic Business Partnership 

  • Partner with senior leadership to develop and execute Talent strategies aligned to short- and long-term business objectives 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and influencer, providing guidance on organizational design, workforce planning, and leadership effectiveness 

  • Translate business needs into actionable Talent solutions, driving measurable impact 

  • Lead and influence change management initiatives across the organization

Data Analytics & Insights 

  • Leverage workforce data (turnover, engagement, performance, succession, etc.) to identify trends and root causes 

  • Develop and deliver executive-level presentations and insights that inform decision-making 

  • Use analytics to proactively shape talent strategy, retention plans, and organizational health 

  • Drive accountability through metrics, scorecards, and ongoing business reviews 

Employee Relations & Legal Compliance 

  • Partner with local Employee Relations Team and leaders to navigate employee relations matters, providing clear guidance, coaching, and risk-based recommendations aligned with company policy and legal standards 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor, ensuring consistent application of policies, practices, and documentation across the organization 

  • Support resolution of employee concerns through consultation, influence, and partnership with leadership while maintaining fairness, consistency, and objectivity 

  • Support, or in some cases lead, employee investigations based on complexity and risk, ensuring thorough documentation, fact-based decision-making, and alignment with legal and compliance standards 

  • Drive leader accountability for proper documentation, consistency in decision-making, and adherence to policy 

  • Ensure adherence to federal, state, and local employment laws and company policies; proactively identify and mitigate potential risk areas 

  • Partner with local Employee Relations Team or Director of Talent Management on escalations, ensuring audit-ready documentation, defensible outcomes, and adherence to required processes and timelines 

  • Maintains a zero-tolerance approach to documentation gaps, ensuring all employee relations matters are documented timely, accurately, and completely 

  • Support local Employee Relations Partner(s) to ensure all cases, actions, and outcomes are audit-ready at any point, with clear rationale and supporting documentation 

Performance & Talent Management 

  • Drive performance management processes, including coaching, development planning, and performance improvement 

  • Facilitate talent reviews, succession planning, and leadership pipeline development 

  • Lead internal talent mobility efforts to align workforce capabilities with business needs  

  • Partner with leaders on promotions, compensation recommendations, and organizational structure 

Employee Experience & Engagement 

  • Support and execute engagement strategies (surveys, skip-levels, stay/exit interviews, action planning)  

  • Identify opportunities to enhance culture, retention, and employee experience 

  • Drive leader accountability for engagement outcomes and action plans 

Organizational Development & Change 

  • Partner with leadership and on occasion Talent Development to support organizational transitions and capability building 

  • Influence leadership behaviors that drive performance, inclusion, and culture 

  • Lead initiatives that strengthen bench strength and long-term workforce readiness 

 

The TOOLS you'll bring with you:

Required 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience) 

  • 7+ years of progressive HR/Talent experience, including business partnership/manager 

  • Proven experience partnering with senior leaders (Director+ level) 

  • Strong knowledge of employee relations, employment law, and compliance practices  

  • Advanced data analytics, reporting, and presentation skills 

  • Demonstrated ability to influence decision-making and drive results through others 

  • Exceptional communication skills (written, verbal, and executive-level storytelling with data)

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have: 

  • Experience in distribution, or operations environments 

  • Experience leading organizational design or transformation initiatives 

  • Strong project management and change management capabilities 

 

Core Competencies 

  • Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen 

  • Executive Communication & Influence 

  • Strong Data-Driven Decision Making 

  • Time Management, Prioritizing, and Follow-up 

  • Attention to Detail 

  • Employee Relations Expertise 

  • Leadership Coaching & Development 

  • Change Leadership 

  • Organizational Effectiveness 

  • Integrity, Judgment, and Confidentiality 

 

What Success Looks Like 

  • Earns and maintains a credible, trusted seat at the table with senior leaders 

  • Drives measurable improvements in retention, engagement, and performance 

  • Anticipates business needs and proactively delivers talent solutions 

  • Builds strong leadership capability and organizational bench strength 

  • Balances strategic influence with operational execution in a fast-paced environment 

  • We reserve the right to make scheduling adjustments based on business need; the ideal candidate requires scheduling flexibility to meet the needs of the business across all shifts, and permanent schedule changes with reasonable notice.     

 

We provide these great perks and benefits: 

  • Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans 

  • Generous 401 (K) savings plan 

  • Education assistance 

  • On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service 

  • And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

rows.title: Metrology Data, Systems, and Automation Engineer

detail.title: Metrology Data, Systems, and Automation Engineer
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and have an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that’s why we invest in an individual’s growth and development from day one.

Our fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, state-of-the-art quality controls and cross-functional agility.

Your Role on Our Team

As a Metrology Data, Systems, and Automation Engineer, you will help modernize metrology operations by improving how measurement data is collected, organized, analyzed, reported, and connected across engineering, quality, manufacturing, supplier, and enterprise systems. This role is well suited for candidates with experience in metrology, quality engineering, manufacturing engineering, software automation, data analytics, systems integration, technical applications support, or related technical disciplines. You will evaluate and implement new technologies, develop practical automation and reporting solutions, and serve as a technical bridge between Metrology Engineering, IT, and cross-functional business partners.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

  • Research, evaluate, and recommend metrology hardware, inspection software, automation tools, AI-enabled solutions, data platforms, and digital reporting technologies.
  • Lead feasibility studies, benchmarking, implementation planning, testing criteria, documentation, training, and change management for new metrology applications and workflows.
  • Design and implement software-based solutions that improve metrology data flow, reporting speed, traceability, usability, and integration with enterprise systems.
  • Develop scripts, tools, automated workflows, low-code solutions, AI agents, bots, dashboards, or standardized templates for data extraction, transformation, report generation, workflow automation, and performance tracking.
  • Serve as the primary technical link between Metrology Engineering and IT for software tools, system integrations, database connectivity, permissions, cybersecurity, licensing, file architecture, and digital infrastructure.
  • Translate metrology, quality, manufacturing, and engineering workflow needs into clear business and technical requirements while aligning operational needs with scalable, supportable solutions.
  • Drive standardization of metrology software workflows, naming structures, file organization, data storage methods, reporting practices, and digital lifecycle control.
  • Support continuous improvement projects that improve metrology efficiency, quality system compliance, reporting consistency, and digital transformation.
  • Collaborate with global and regional teams to share best practices, support user adoption, and build repeatable solutions that can scale across laboratories, suppliers, and manufacturing environments.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Technology, Quality, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
  • 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: metrology, quality engineering, manufacturing engineering, inspection technology, software applications, data analytics, automation, systems integration, technical support, or related technical work.
  • Exposure to metrology, inspection, quality, manufacturing, or engineering systems such as CMMs, vision systems, optical scanners, laser scanners, CT/X-ray, gages, test equipment, CAD-based inspection, or related technologies.
  • Hands-on experience improving data handling, reporting, automation, scripting, programming, dashboards, databases, or workflow tools in an engineering, quality, manufacturing, lab, or technical business environment.
  • Interest in or experience with AI, AI agents, bots, low-code tools, or workflow automation used to improve data handling, reporting, troubleshooting, user support, or process efficiency.
  • Working knowledge of one or more tools such as Python, VBA, SQL, Excel automation, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Automate, APIs, database tools, reporting platforms, or similar automation and data solutions.
  • Ability to understand technical workflows, structure data, document processes, troubleshoot issues, and communicate information clearly to both technical and non-technical users.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, organization, collaboration, project coordination, and continuous improvement skills.

Other TOOLS that are nice to have:

  • Familiarity with metrology or inspection software such as PC-DMIS, PolyWorks, Zeiss Inspect, Calypso, Geomagic, DataLoop, or similar platforms.
  • Experience integrating data across metrology platforms, lab systems, quality systems, manufacturing systems, enterprise tools, databases, APIs, cloud services, or IT-supported software environments.
  • Experience applying AI-enabled tools, copilots, agents, bots, or low-code automation to engineering, quality, lab, or manufacturing workflows.
  • Experience with CAD-based inspection workflows, GD&T interpretation, measurement validation, MSA, Gage R&R, capability studies, or quality management system requirements.
  • Background supporting digital transformation, automated reporting, dashboard development, software implementation, user training, technical documentation, or systems integration projects in a lab, engineering, quality, manufacturing, or supplier environment.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

detail.title: Principal Advanced Quality Engineer - Textiles
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization, that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch on every step of the process, that is why our Operations teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

The Principal AQE – Textiles primary duties are to utilize advanced engineering expertise in the Textiles field to contribute to the development and qualification of innovative products and to mentor other engineers cross-functionally to improve the department’s technical skills. The Principal AQE is a critical member of the New Product Development (NPD) team reporting to Quality Engineering leadership. Throughout a product’s development cycle, this position requires strong cross-functional communication skills and analytical experience to help launch new and exciting solutions that meet our user’s needs. You will work in a fast-paced environment to innovate new products and textile material solutions as a member of a cross-functional team. The Principal AQE may be asked to act as mentor to junior level AQEs on NPD projects in addition to their normal workload.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Product and Material Development

  • Act as a Textiles Subject Matter Expert (SME) helping NPD teams determine optimal materials and designs to improve product performance and meet user expectations

  • Interface with Front End Innovation (FEI) team to adapt highly innovative textile materials to production

  • Participate in user need research to identify “critical to quality” (CtQ) requirements on materials selection, design features, and construction methods for knit and sewn products

  • Collaborate with Engineering and Marketing to define the products' specifications leading in all aspects of performance, quality, reliability, and testing

  • Lead Risk Assessments (Design and Manufacturing) for NPD projects during the product development cycle

Supplier & Manufacturing

  • Lead supplier process and QMS audits focused on textile-specific risks

  • Establish process capability expectations for textile production at finished goods factories and material facilities as required

  • Ensure timely failure reporting and lead root cause analysis and effective corrective/preventative actions (FRACA)

Testing/Analysis

  • Lead development of capability at multiple test laboratories implementing new and innovative test methods to better quantify product performance

  • Own interpretation of global textile performance standards and drive correlation between testing at internal labs and regulatory labs

  • Develop test plans and prove out test methods based on new or established product designs to ensure products meet customer requirements

  • Perform DOE to support Engineering in their understanding of quality concerns and improvements to design

  • Analyze, draw conclusions, report and present product information utilizing statistical techniques such as Weibull analysis, reliability distributions and matrices

  • Communicate concise, logical, written conclusions from experiments based on data analysis

Mentoring/Leadership

  • Mentor junior level AQEs in developing CtQ requirements, test methodologies and design, setting production specifications and creation of design of experiments

  • This position is recognized as a topic expert within the AQE teams, it will be asked to provide, as need, training, mentoring and guidance to REs related to that topic

Job Requirements:

  • Position requires 70% of its time supporting product development work with 30% of its time dedicated to systemic and AQE organizational improvement/development

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or educational equivalent field

  • 10+ years of experience directly supporting textiles or soft goods product quality

  • Experience with new product commercialization processes emphasizing design, manufacturing, quality, test or reliability activities

  • Experience including training in quality engineering fundamentals and proven experience leading a primary function within a project team

  • Previous relevant experience with Design of Experiments, life data analysis, and other related statistical tools and software (i.e. Minitab, Reliasoft)

  • Demonstrate skills in mentoring other employees in statistical techniques

  • Written and verbal communication skills and creative problem-solving capabilities

  • Ability to travel 20% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International)

  • Preferred: ASQ Reliability Engineering Certification (ASQ-CRE) or the ability and desire to achieve certification

  • Preferred: Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) or Six Sigma experience

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

Staff Industrial Designer

Job Description:

Position Overview: As a Staff Industrial Designer at Milwaukee Tool, you will help shape innovative products that solve real user needs and push our design language forward. This is an exciting mid-level role for a highly curious, hands-on designer with 3+ years of professional experience who thrives in fast-paced product development. You will explore form, function, aesthetics, and user interaction while transforming insights into compelling concepts and manufacturable solutions. Designing products that expand a growing system of storage and accessories. Working with increasing autonomy and in close partnership with senior designers, engineering, marketing, and research teams, you will play a key role in bringing impactful, user-driven products to life. This position reports to the Lead Industrial Designer or ID Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Concept Generation: Explore ideas through ideation, competitive assessments, and identification of unmet user needs. Collaborate with future conceptual teams to explore ideas for the future of Milwaukee.

  • Design Development: Create designs using paper and digital sketching, technical drawings, renderings, 2D illustrations, 3D CAD, and hand-built mock-ups and models. Consider manufacturing and cost parameters. Develop products that fit into a complex system.

  • Visual Storytelling: Communicate design intent through visual storytelling to gain acceptance from the project team.

  • Innovation: Be very curious and seek to understand and inject innovation into all programs and tasks.

  • Form Development: Demonstrate a strong understanding of form development and the ability to create designs without predecessors.

  • Collaboration: Participate in brainstorming and concept generation events. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, primarily marketing and engineering, to deliver designs based on established criteria. Attend weekly meetings, teleconferences, and lead design reviews with process partners and design peers.

  • Documentation: Create necessary documentation to convey design solutions to management or cross-functional partners through renderings, models, mechanical drawings, and written reports. Present designs for milestone approval to marketing and engineering leadership.

  • Ergonomics and Usability: Evaluate and apply fundamentals of ergonomics and usability to product solutions.

  • Research Participation: Participate in internal research downloads, review research reports, and engage in hands-on project activities. Regularly participate in observational job site visits to understand user requirements. Collaborate with Design Research and Product Management teams to analyze and shape observations into valuable insights.

  • Construction, Materials & VBL Guidelines: Propose construction, mechanisms, color, materials, surface finish, and manufacturing processes in cooperation with other business functions involved in new product development. Ensure designs comply with Milwaukee visual brand language (VBL) guidelines.

  • Manufacturing Integration: Partner closely with engineering and suppliers to ensure design intent is maintained through manufacturing. Develop solutions optimized for injection molding, assembly processes, and scalable production while balancing cost, quality, and performance.

  • Trend Monitoring: Continually monitor design trends involving form, materials, technology, etc..

  • Project Management: Work on several projects concurrently and respond quickly to accelerated changes in project directions.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional design experience.

  • Strong understanding of form development and the ability to innovate.

  • Proficiency in paper and digital sketching, technical drawings, renderings, 2D illustrations, 3D CAD, and model making.

  • Excellent communication skills for presentations, visual storytelling, and working with global partners.

  • Ability to work on multiple projects concurrently and adapt to changes quickly.

  • Knowledge of ergonomics, usability, and manufacturing processes.

  • Familiarity with Milwaukee products and use of tools in general is a plus.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to innovative product designs and collaborate with a dynamic team. If you are passionate about industrial design and eager to make an impact, we encourage you to apply!

detail.title: Senior Design Researcher
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Are you looking for a career with a growing company and the opportunity to help build the role of Design Research as a core competency for a business? Looking for a challenging and quick paced environment? Then look no further than our Senior Design Researcher role for Milwaukee Tool.

Milwaukee Tool is an industry-leading manufacturer of heavy-duty power tools, accessories and hand tools for professional users worldwide.

Since the company began in 1924, Milwaukee Tool has led the industry in both durability and performance.  With an unwavering commitment to the trades, Milwaukee continues to lead with a focus on providing innovative, trade-specific solutions.  Whether it is through their leadership in LITHIUM-ION technology, as seen in the M12™, M18™ & M28™ Systems, time-saving accessories or innovative hand tool products,  Milwaukee is dedicated to delivering a steady stream of advanced solutions for the trades that offer increased productivity and unmatched durability.

To do this, Milwaukee takes the time to work side by side with real craftsman to understand the demands of a constantly changing workplace and how they can best deliver solutions that help the user work both faster and smarter. Milwaukee knows that professional users sweat the small stuff, and so do they. They pay attention to the small details that that make a big difference. This user focus not only leads to solutions for real jobsite challenges, but fuels the disruptive innovation seen across all product lines.

Milwaukee offers benefits on your first day of work (health, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k) and an excellent working environment that includes an on-site cafeteria, state of the art fitness facility, organized fitness classes, recreational sports leagues and company outings. 

You must be permanently eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship for this position.

Senior Design Researcher

The Design Research team at Milwaukee Tool sits within a collaborative user-centered design and technology development group focused on the fuzzy front end of product development. We are tasked with informing the entrepreneurial spirit of the company, influencing and inspiring the direction of the business through strategic and functional findings. In this role you will be leading the research efforts of highly collaborative and diverse teams of Engineers, Industrial Designers, and Product Managers to inspire and influence key decision makers on new solutions for the construction industry. As a senior member of the team you will also provide leadership in developing new methods and approaches, championing Design Research and Design Thinking at Milwaukee Tool, and coaching and mentoring junior-level researchers as needed.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design and conduct multi-faceted research plans to learn about all aspects of the construction trade. These plans typically include qualitative discovery research on jobsites, primary and secondary research exercises to understand the competitive product set, and evaluation of mock-ups and preliminary concept prototypes in field.

  • Build, grow, and maintain a network of users to understand their evolving needs and work context. Establishing strong relationships with our end users is critical to conducting appropriate discovery research, co-creating solutions, and eliciting honest feedback.

  • Analyze and synthesize research findings into key insights that inform opportunities for new feature sets, functionalities and business approaches.

  • Plan and facilitate hands-on tool evaluations, team workshops, and analysis sessions. These participatory co-creation sessions result in a common ground of familiarity with a tool and its use, while inspiring creativity and collaboration within your team.

  • Present research findings in an engaging and concise manner to key stakeholders across the business. You will need to communicate through well-crafted presentations and events that educate and inspire your team through photos, video, diagrams, storytelling and demonstrations.

  • Experiment with new approaches and methodologies to achieve ingenious results.  As a research group we encourage new ways of thinking, and we want you to help us build new tools and methodologies appropriate to the work we do.

  • Champion the importance of User-Centered Design and Design Thinking throughout the company.

  • Mentor and coach junior researchers as appropriate.

Required Skills

  • You are curious, not just about your research topic but also the company, your co-workers, and your process

  • You are comfortable working in the ambiguous “fuzzy front end”

  • You are a strategic thinker who looks not only at the stated problem but at the space around it

  • You are proactive and open to changing research plans on the fly based on new information

  • You have strong communication skills and can get your ideas across to engineers, industrial designers, and marketers alike

  • You link everything back to our core end user’s activities and needs to provide insight for developing breakthrough products

  • You are a team player, focused on bringing the team along on the journey

  • You have passion for the importance of user insights in the product development process and are ready to champion those insights

  • You are comfortable facilitating conversations with multi-disciplinary teams

  • You make non-obvious connections and revel in talking about ideas

  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office, with some experience with editing video and 2D software (ex: Adobe Creative Suite)

Desired Skills

  • Experience within a design consultancy a plus

  • Some familiarity with quantitative research methodologies, study design and data analysis

  • An appreciation of how quantitative and qualitative research methodologies play best together

  • Master’s degree preferred

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Anthropology, Sociology, Industrial Design, Graphic Design, Business, or Engineering

  • Five years + experience in the fuzzy front end of product development with an understanding of innovation methods and design thinking

  • Five years + experience using qualitative research methods including observation, interviewing, and contextual inquiry

  • 25-35% overnight domestic travel

  • Must have a valid driver's license

  • Upon an interview, must be prepared to present on a project and its methodology

detail.title: Reliability Engineer II - Plumbing and Electrical
detail.jobDescription:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.  Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.


The Reliability Engineer II is responsible for utilizing engineering skills to contribute to the development and qualification of power tool products. The Reliability Engineer defines the test methods, analytical processes and product requirements necessary to deliver durable, disruptive, and market-leading products.

Strong candidates will bring attention to detail, accountability, and broad experiences in systems engineering, test development, validation, and data acquisition/analytics to the development team. The candidate thrives in a fast-paced work environment, executing various reliability and quality engineering deliverables, with excellent visibility and opportunities to grow.

This role will support complex plumbing, electrical, and mechanical trades power tools.

 Duties and Responsibilities

 Product Development 

  • Be a subject matter expert in the development team with respect to test methods, product requirements, user needs, and data analytics

  • Manage user needs and design requirements from collaboration with product management and participation in user research

  • Collaborate with design engineers and marketing to define product specifications with respect to reliable life, durability, quality, features, and other user needs

  • Design experimental and analytical techniques to improve development, testing and qualification efforts

  • Interact with global engineers, suppliers, manufacturing, distribution and service partners that support the product development process

  • Proactively identify risks through critical thinking, data analysis, design reviews, and test results

  • Track and support multiple projects simultaneously to ensure adherence to schedule and Milwaukee Tool quality expectations

 Testing and Analysis 

  • Develop new test methods and repeatable procedures which global test labs can follow to evaluate product performance against user and design requirements

  • Effectively document test plans, procedures, schedule and best practices for execution

  • Support creation of complex test fixtures, GR&R, and correlation studies that meet project cost and schedule

  • Execute robustness tests to ensure our products are Nothing but HEAVY DUTY

  • Perform data analysis, post-processing, and visualization of test data, reliability growth and demonstration

  • Summarize test results with statistical techniques and present concise, logical, written and/or verbal conclusions

  • Ensure timely failure reporting and drive root cause analysis and effective corrective/preventative actions with all stakeholders

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical or related engineering field with 2+ years of experience in product development, systems, reliability, test, and/or quality roles

  • Experience with or desire to learn:

    • Analytical problem-solving skills and statistical application in areas such as Design of Experiments, sampling techniques, regression, reliability, FMEAs, hypothesis testing, etc.

    • Test development and design verification and validation.  Experience with HALT, accelerated life and other reliability test methods a plus

    • Life data analysis, reliability distributions, and related software (e.g. Minitab, Reliasoft Weibull++)

    • Hands-on data acquisition systems, data analytics, and related software (e.g. Python, nCode Glyphworks, Dewesoft)

    • Systems engineering fundamentals, requirements management and proven ability to lead a primary function within a project team

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence at all levels with creative problem-solving capabilities

  • Demonstrates excellent organizational skills and ability to support multiple projects simultaneously

  • Knowledge / Experience with the phases of residential and commercial construction and the equipment used is a plus

  • Ability to travel 5-10% (includes both domestic and international)

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Description:
